text-anchor="start">eRecept je standard: lékař ho vystaví do centrálního úložiště,</text><text x="294.0" y="795.9" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">pacient dostane identifikátor. Listinný recept zůstává pro výpadky.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="823.2" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="829.2" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">3</text><text x="64.0" y="828.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Průkazka pacienta</text><text x="294.0" y="828.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Náležitosti: pacient (jméno, číslo pojištěnce) · léčivo (název,</text><text x="294.0" y="848.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">síla, forma, množství) · dávkování a způsob podání (D.S.) · lékař a</text><text x="294.0" y="868.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">pracoviště s podpisem a razítkem · datum.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="896.2" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="902.2" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">4</text><text x="64.0" y="901.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Modrý pruh</text><text x="294.0" y="901.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Vyhrazen omamným a psychotropním látkám; přísnější evidence.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="928.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="934.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">5</text><text x="64.0" y="933.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Třecí miska</text><text x="294.0" y="933.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Magistraliter předpis má stavbu Rp. (recipe) — složení — M.f.</text><text x="294.0" y="953.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">(misce fiat) — D.S. (da signa).</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="981.2" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="987.2" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="64.0" y="986.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Kalendář na zdi</text><text x="294.0" y="986.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Platnost běžného receptu je zpravidla 14 dní, u antibiotik kratší</text><text x="294.0" y="1006.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">[⚠️ ověřit dle skript]. Opakovací recept uvádí počet opakování.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1033.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1039.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">7</text><text x="64.0" y="1038.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Výměna krabiček</text><text x="294.0" y="1038.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Generická substituce — lékárník smí vydat jiný přípravek se stejnou</text><text x="294.0" y="1059.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">účinnou látkou, silou a formou, pokud to lékař nezakázal a pacient</text><text x="294.0" y="1079.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">souhlasí.</text><rect x="27.0" y="1105.8" width="846.0" height="62.5" rx="10" fill="#F7CFC4" opacity="0.42"/><path d="M29.0,1106.7 L868.2,1104.9 Q872.6,1104.4 871.1,1108.4 L875.2,1165.8 Q872.4,1172.7 867.2,1167.9 L32.1,1172.4 Q24.8,1167.3 23.8,1166.1 L28.5,1108.1 Q25.9,1102.3 35.3,1106.0" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><path d="M31.3,1102.3 L867.9,1103.9 Q872.4,1105.8 876.2,1112.4 L871.5,1160.1 Q872.2,1170.7 867.1,1171.0 L33.2,1172.6 Q29.0,1167.8 23.8,1165.7 L25.5,1113.3 Q23.5,1105.5 31.6,1106.6" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><text x="40.0" y="1126.8" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">⚠️</text><text x="66.0" y="1126.8" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">Před předepsáním patří anamnéza: alergie, gravidita a kojení, funkce jater a ledvin a všechny ostatní</text><text x="66.0" y="1146.1" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">léky včetně volně prodejných.</text></svg>

x="294.0" y="816.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">mikrodávkami s pomalou eskalací.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="843.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">FÁZE III — tisíce nemocných: srovnání s dosavadní léčbou nebo</text><text x="294.0" y="901.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">placebem; na jejím základě se registruje.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="928.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="934.5" font-size="17" y="933.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">FÁZE IV — po uvedení na trh, běžná populace. Teprve tady se odhalí</text><text x="294.0" y="953.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">VZÁCNÉ nežádoucí účinky, protože ve studii na tisících neměly stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1007.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="64.0" y="1006.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Kostka randomizace</text><text x="294.0" y="1006.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Zásady studie: randomizace, zaslepení (jednoduché, y="1047.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">komise.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1074.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" tedy</text><text x="294.0" y="1099.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">shodný průběh hladin s originálem.</text><rect x="27.0" y="1126.1" width="846.0" proto nitroglycerin pod jazyk.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="843.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="849.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">3</text><text x="64.0" y="848.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Stříkačka na cestě</text><text x="294.0" y="848.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">I.V.: okamžitý účinek a biologická dostupnost 100 % — ale podané se</text><text x="294.0" y="868.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">nedá vzít zpět.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="896.2" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="902.2" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">4</text><text x="64.0" y="901.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Sval u cesty</text><text x="294.0" y="901.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">I.M. rychlé, S.C. pomalejší (inzulin, hepariny); dále intratekálně,</text><text x="294.0" y="921.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">intraartikulárně, intraoseálně. Vyžadují sterilitu a personál.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="948.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="954.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">5</text><text x="64.0" y="953.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Náplast na plotě</text><text x="294.0" y="953.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">TRANSDERMÁLNĚ — nejpomalejší nástup, ale stálá hladina po dny; po</text><text x="294.0" y="974.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">sejmutí účinek doznívá z kožního depa.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1001.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1007.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="64.0" y="1006.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Zadní vrátka</text><text x="294.0" y="1006.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">REKTÁLNĚ — funguje při zvracení a u dětí, játra obchází jen zčásti</text><text x="294.0" y="1026.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">(dolní část konečníku), vstřebávání je kolísavé.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1054.1" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1060.1" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">7</text><text x="64.0" y="1059.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Oko nad krajinou</text><text x="294.0" y="1059.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">„Místní“ podání neznamená „bez celkového účinku“ — timolol z očních</text><text x="294.0" y="1079.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">kapek vyvolá bradykardii a bronchospasmus.</text><rect x="27.0" y="1105.8" width="846.0" (xylometazolin) jen 5–7 DNÍ, jinak vzniká rhinitis</text><text x="294.0" y="816.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">medicamentosa. Rozhoduje</text><text x="294.0" y="921.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">TECHNIKA inhalace; nástavec zlepší depozici a sníží orofaryngeální</text><text x="294.0" y="941.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">kandidózu a chrapot po inhalačním kortikoidu.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="969.2" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="975.2" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">5</text><text x="64.0" y="974.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Čípek</text><text x="294.0" y="974.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Rektalia obcházejí játra jen z dolní části konečníku, vstřebávání</text><text x="294.0" y="994.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">je kolísavé; hodí se u zvracení, u dětí a v bezvědomí (diazepam u</text><text x="294.0" y="1014.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">křečí).</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1042.1" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1048.1" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="64.0" y="1047.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" i odsud</text><text x="294.0" y="1067.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">se látka částečně vstřebává.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1094.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" vstřebávají a mohou</text><text x="294.0" y="1120.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">působit celkově.</text><rect x="27.0" y="1146.5" width="846.0" height="62.5" text-anchor="start">COMPLIANCE — míra, do jaké pacient dodržuje pokyny; pasivní pojetí.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="750.2" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" ruky</text><text x="294.0" y="755.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">ADHERENCE — pacient se na plánu podílel; KONKORDANCE je společné</text><text x="294.0" y="775.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">rozhodnutí lékaře a pacienta. Dnes se preferuje adherence, protože</text><text x="294.0" y="795.9" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">zdůrazňuje spoluodpovědnost.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="823.2" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="829.2" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">3</text><text x="64.0" y="828.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Jiskra nad hlavou</text><text x="294.0" y="828.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">PLACEBO — očekávané zlepšení; má neurobiologický podklad (endogenní</text><text x="294.0" y="848.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">opioidy, dopamin), není „vymyšlené“ a zesiluje účinek každého</text><text x="294.0" y="868.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">skutečného léku.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="896.2" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="902.2" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">4</text><text x="64.0" y="901.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Mrak s bleskem</text><text x="294.0" y="901.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">NOCEBO — očekávaná škoda; nepříznivé věty a příbalový leták</text><text x="294.0" y="921.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">vyvolají potíž. Odsud časté vysazení statinů a antidepresiv.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="948.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="954.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">5</text><text x="64.0" y="953.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Hromada krabiček</text><text x="294.0" y="953.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Nejčastější příčina selhání léčby není špatný lék, ale NEBRANÝ lék:</text><text x="294.0" y="974.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">složitý režim, mnoho tablet, nežádoucí účinky a obavy z nich, cena,</text><text x="294.0" y="994.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">nepochopení, nedůvěra.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1021.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1027.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="64.0" y="1026.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Jedna tableta denně</text><text x="294.0" y="1026.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Zlepší to fixní kombinace (méně tablet), dávkování 1× denně,</text><text x="294.0" y="1047.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">srozumitelné vysvětlení a kontrola.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1074.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1080.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">7</text><text x="64.0" y="1079.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Mluvící lékař</text><text x="294.0" y="1079.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Formulace lékaře je sama o sobě účinná látka s vlastní dávkou —</text><text x="294.0" y="1099.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">proto se způsob sdělení plánuje stejně jako dávka.</text><rect x="27.0" y="1126.1" width="846.0" height="62.5" rx="10" fill="#F7CFC4" opacity="0.42"/><path d="M30.4,1121.9 L867.9,1127.6 Q875.1,1124.7 871.3,1132.4 L872.6,1181.1 Q875.0,1187.7 867.2,1188.0 L33.7,1190.8 Q26.2,1192.1 23.5,1182.7 L27.1,1131.1 Q26.2,1123.0 opacity="0.8"/><text x="40.0" y="1147.1" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">⚠️</text><text x="66.0" y="1147.1" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" x="294.0" y="697.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Membrána je lipidová dvojvrstva — projde jen látka LIPOFILNÍ a</text><text x="294.0" y="718.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">NENABITÁ; ionizovaná forma neprojde.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="745.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Chodec po svahu</text><text x="294.0" y="750.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">PROSTÁ DIFUZE — po koncentračním spádu, bez energie a bez</text><text x="294.0" y="770.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">přenašeče; hlavní mechanismus u většiny léčiv.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="798.1" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="804.1" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">3</text><text x="64.0" y="803.1" font-size="15.4" spádu, spotřebuje ATP, je saturovatelný</text><text x="294.0" y="823.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">(P-glykoprotein léčiva aktivně vypuzuje z buňky). Facilitovaná</text><text x="294.0" y="843.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">difuze jde přenašečem, ale po spádu a bez energie.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="871.1" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="877.1" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">4</text><text x="64.0" y="876.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Past za zdí</text><text x="294.0" y="876.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">IONTOVÁ PAST: látka projde v nenabité formě, na druhé straně se při</text><text x="294.0" y="896.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">jiném pH nabije a zpět už neprojde — hromadí se. Proto alkalizace</text><text x="294.0" y="916.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">moči urychlí vyloučení salicylátů.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="944.1" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="950.1" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">5</text><text x="64.0" y="949.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Hlídaná brána do mozku</text><text x="294.0" y="949.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Hematoencefalická bariéra — těsné spoje a P-glykoprotein. Zánět ji</text><text x="294.0" y="969.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">zpropustní: penicilin proniká do CNS jen při meningitidě.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="996.7" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1002.7" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="64.0" y="1001.7" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Placenta</text><text x="294.0" y="1001.7" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Placentární bariéra je PROPUSTNĚJŠÍ, než se obvykle čeká — většina</text><text x="294.0" y="1022.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">léčiv jí projde.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1049.4" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1055.4" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">7</text><text x="64.0" y="1054.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Anestetikum v zánětu</text><text x="294.0" y="1054.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">V kyselém zánětlivém prostředí převáží nabitá forma lokálního</text><text x="294.0" y="1074.7" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">anestetika, která neprojde k sodíkovému kanálu — proto tam</text><text x="294.0" y="1095.0" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">nezabírá.</text><rect x="27.0" y="1121.4" width="846.0" distribuční objem Vd</text><text x="294.0" y="795.9" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">(poměr dávky k plazmatické koncentraci).</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="823.2" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="829.2" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">3</text><text x="64.0" y="828.2" — přeměna, hlavně v játrech; I. fáze (oxidace,</text><text x="294.0" y="848.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">redukce, hydrolýza) a II. fáze (konjugace).</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="875.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="881.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">EXKRECE — vyloučení, hlavně ledvinami; dále žlučí, plícemi, mlékem.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="908.2" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="914.2" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">5</text><text x="64.0" y="913.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Spojka M + E</text><text x="294.0" y="913.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">ELIMINACE = metabolismus PLUS exkrece. Není totéž co vylučování —</text><text x="294.0" y="933.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">to je jen její část.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="960.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="966.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="64.0" y="965.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Vodárna</text><text x="294.0" y="965.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">CLEARANCE — objem krve zcela očištěný za jednotku času; sčítá se</text><text x="294.0" y="986.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">renální a jaterní.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1013.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1019.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">7</text><text x="64.0" y="1018.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Půlená cedule</text><text x="294.0" y="1018.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Biologický poločas — doba poklesu na polovinu. Ustálený stav</text><text x="294.0" y="1038.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">nastane za 4–5 poločasů a stejně dlouho trvá vymizení.</text><rect x="27.0" y="1065.1" width="846.0" height="62.5" rx="10" fill="#F7CFC4" opacity="0.42"/><path d="M29.3,1062.0 L868.6,1065.0 Q874.3,1066.7 874.3,1067.0 L871.3,1120.1 Q876.8,1130.8 868.9,1132.0 L28.7,1125.8 Q27.5,1129.1 25.1,1123.6 L24.1,1069.5 Q23.2,1063.0 29.0,1062.4" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><path d="M32.3,1064.2 L867.2,1062.1 Q876.4,1062.4 876.3,1068.1 L876.3,1120.9 Q875.0,1131.5 865.1,1130.5 L33.2,1130.7 Q26.5,1130.5 29.0,1123.2 L26.9,1070.4 Q27.3,1066.0 32.9,1066.0" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><text x="40.0" y="1086.1" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">⚠️</text><text x="66.0" y="1086.1" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">Vysoké Vd znamená, že látka sedí ve tkáních, ne v krvi — proto ji hemodialýza neodstraní (digoxin,</text><text x="66.0" y="1105.4" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">antidepresiva).</text></svg>

Pokles je lineární a</text><text x="294.0" y="836.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">poločas ztrácí smysl.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="863.8" r="15" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Korbel piva</text><text x="294.0" y="868.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Ethanol se odbourává řádově 0,1–0,15 ‰ za hodinu, vždy stejně —</text><text x="294.0" y="889.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">proto NELZE počítat „za dva poločasy bude polovina“ a rychlost</text><text x="294.0" y="909.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">nejde urychlit.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="936.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="942.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">4</text><text x="64.0" y="941.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Výhybka</text><text x="294.0" y="941.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Michaelisova–Mentenové (saturační) kinetika je přechod mezi obojím:</text><text x="294.0" y="962.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">při nízké koncentraci první řád, po nasycení enzymu nultý.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="989.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="995.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">5</text><text x="64.0" y="994.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Přetékající hrnec</text><text x="294.0" y="994.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">U saturačního léčiva stačí malé zvýšení dávky a hladina vyskočí do</text><text x="294.0" y="1014.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">toxického pásma — fenytoin (nystagmus, ataxie, zmatenost),</text><text x="294.0" y="1035.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">salicyláty, theofylin. Proto se měří hladiny.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1062.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1068.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="64.0" y="1067.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Čtyři zářezy</text><text x="294.0" y="1067.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Ustálený stav nastane za 4–5 poločasů a stejně dlouho trvá vymizení</text><text x="294.0" y="1087.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">po vysazení.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1115.1" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1121.1" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">7</text><text x="64.0" y="1120.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Nasycovací dávka</text><text x="294.0" y="1120.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">U dlouhého poločasu se čekání zkracuje nasycovací dávkou.</text><rect x="27.0" y="1146.5" width="846.0" height="62.5" rx="10" fill="#F7CFC4" opacity="0.42"/><path d="M30.6,1142.8 L868.8,1144.0 Q871.8,1143.3 873.3,1153.5 L870.6,1203.0 Q875.0,1207.2 864.9,1209.4 L32.3,1212.7 Q28.9,1210.3 25.7,1203.6 L26.4,1149.3 font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">Poločas má smysl jen u kinetiky prvního řádu — u nultého řádu se mění s koncentrací, a proto se</text><text x="66.0" y="1186.7" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">neuvádí.</text></svg>

podle ní se</text><text x="294.0" y="864.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">srovnává originál s generikem (bioekvivalence).</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="891.4" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="897.4" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">4</text><text x="64.0" y="896.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Vrátnice s výběrčím</text><text x="294.0" y="896.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Biologická dostupnost F = podíl dávky, který se dostane NEZMĚNĚNÝ</text><text x="294.0" y="916.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">do systémového oběhu; snižuje ji neúplné vstřebání a first-pass</text><text x="294.0" y="937.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">metabolismus.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="964.4" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="970.4" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">5</text><text x="64.0" y="969.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Stopky</text><text x="294.0" y="969.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">tmax vypovídá o RYCHLOSTI vstřebávání, Cmax a AUC o jeho ROZSAHU.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="996.7" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1002.7" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="64.0" y="1001.7" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Sklenice mléka</text><text x="294.0" y="1001.7" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Vstřebání ovlivní léková forma, rozpustnost, pH, jídlo, motilita a</text><text x="294.0" y="1022.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">prokrvení; antacida, železo a vápník váží tetracykliny a chinolony.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1049.4" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1055.4" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">7</text><text x="64.0" y="1054.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Dvě shodné křivky</text><text x="294.0" y="1054.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Generikum musí mít shodné AUC i Cmax v předepsaném rozmezí — proto</text><text x="294.0" y="1074.7" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">se u něj nezkoumá znovu účinnost.</text><rect x="27.0" y="1101.0" width="846.0" height="62.5" rx="10" fill="#F7CFC4" opacity="0.42"/><path d="M29.2,1096.7 L868.1,1101.7 Q874.4,1100.4 877.0,1103.6 L870.8,1156.0 Q872.5,1167.4 871.2,1165.1 L29.1,1162.3 Q25.1,1162.5 25.3,1161.1 L27.3,1104.8 Q23.9,1103.0 29.2,1103.4" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><path d="M33.0,1102.9 L867.2,1102.0 Q875.9,1101.1 875.2,1104.7 L871.8,1161.2 Q871.7,1165.0 869.1,1166.4 L28.7,1165.8 Q23.9,1166.5 28.4,1156.6 L26.8,1107.4 Q28.8,1099.9 31.7,1102.9" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><text x="40.0" y="1122.0" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">⚠️</text><text x="66.0" y="1122.0" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">Vyšší Cmax při stejném AUC znamená rychlejší, ale krátkodobější účinek — proto retardovaná forma</text><text x="66.0" y="1141.3" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">snižuje Cmax, aniž by měnila celkovou expozici.</text></svg>

font-size="13.5" font-weight="700" fill="#1B6B5F" text-anchor="start">CO JE VE SCÉNĚ</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="745.6" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="751.6" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">1</text><text x="64.0" y="750.6" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Obří nádoba</text><text x="294.0" y="750.6" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Vd = dávka ÷ plazmatická koncentrace. Je to počítaná veličina, ne</text><text x="294.0" y="770.9" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">anatomický prostor — může mnohonásobně převýšit objem těla.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="798.3" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="804.3" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">2</text><text x="64.0" y="803.3" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Gauč ve skladu</text><text x="294.0" y="803.3" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Vysoké Vd = lék uložený ve tkáních (tuk, sval), v krvi ho je málo —</text><text x="294.0" y="823.6" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">proto ho HEMODIALÝZA NEODSTRANÍ (digoxin, antidepresiva).</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="850.9" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="856.9" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">3</text><text x="64.0" y="855.9" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Řetěz k albuminu</text><text x="294.0" y="855.9" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Účinná je jen VOLNÁ frakce. Albumin váže kyselé látky (warfarin,</text><text x="294.0" y="876.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">fenytoin), OROSOMUKOID (kyselý α1-glykoprotein) zásadité. Při</text><text x="294.0" y="896.6" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">hypoalbuminemii stoupá volná frakce a s ní účinek i toxicita.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="923.9" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="929.9" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">4</text><text x="64.0" y="928.9" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Brána do mozku</text><text x="294.0" y="928.9" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Hematoencefalická bariéra — těsné spoje a P-glykoprotein; propustí</text><text x="294.0" y="949.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">jen lipofilní a nenabité látky.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="976.6" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="982.6" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">5</text><text x="64.0" y="981.6" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Placenta</text><text x="294.0" y="981.6" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Placentární bariéra je propustnější, než se čeká — proto se u</text><text x="294.0" y="1001.9" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">gravidity vždy ptáme, co projde k plodu.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1029.2" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1035.2" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="64.0" y="1034.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Usínající pacient</text><text x="294.0" y="1034.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">REDISTRIBUCE: thiopental uspí rychle (jde do mozku) a probudí</text><text x="294.0" y="1054.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">rychle (přesune se do svalu a tuku) — konec účinku dělá PŘESUN, ne</text><text x="294.0" y="1074.9" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">eliminace.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1102.2" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1108.2" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">7</text><text x="64.0" y="1107.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Vytěsnění z vazby</text><text x="294.0" y="1107.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Sulfonamidy vytěsní warfarin z albuminu; samo o sobě bývá klinicky</text><text x="294.0" y="1127.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">přechodné — nebezpečné je, když se přidá i útlum metabolismu.</text><rect x="27.0" y="1153.8" width="846.0" height="62.5" rx="10" fill="#F7CFC4" opacity="0.42"/><path d="M34.8,1151.1 L865.3,1155.7 Q876.9,1155.0 871.5,1159.2 L873.3,1214.2 Q870.7,1220.4 869.4,1220.8 L30.7,1215.7 Q29.1,1215.1 24.5,1214.3 L26.3,1158.3 Q23.9,1155.3 33.9,1155.5" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><path d="M34.9,1151.9 L864.7,1150.8 Q873.2,1149.5 874.7,1162.2 L874.5,1209.2 Q873.9,1218.5 864.7,1214.6 L31.8,1218.0 Q24.4,1214.8 29.0,1212.6 L23.2,1158.3 Q25.7,1153.0 30.6,1152.5" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><text x="40.0" y="1174.8" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">⚠️</text><text x="66.0" y="1174.8" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">Hydrofilní látky mají nízké Vd (zůstávají v krvi a extracelulárně), lipofilní vysoké — proto se u</text><text x="66.0" y="1194.1" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">obézního pacienta liší dávkování podle typu léčiva.</text></svg>

x="294.0" y="697.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">KUMULACE nastane, je-li dávkovací interval kratší než doba potřebná</text><text x="294.0" y="718.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">k eliminaci; hladina se ustálí po 4–5 poločasech.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="745.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="751.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">2</text><text x="64.0" y="750.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Startovací raketa</text><text x="294.0" y="750.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">NASYCOVACÍ dávka = Vd × cílová koncentrace. Podává se, když je</text><text x="294.0" y="770.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">poločas dlouhý a nelze čekat 4–5 poločasů na účinek.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="798.1" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="804.1" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">3</text><text x="64.0" y="803.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Doplňovací konev</text><text x="294.0" y="803.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">UDRŽOVACÍ dávka = CL × cílová koncentrace × interval. Nahrazuje to,</text><text x="294.0" y="823.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">co se za interval vyloučí.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="850.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="856.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">4</text><text x="64.0" y="855.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Plochá vlnovka</text><text x="294.0" y="855.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Krátký interval a malé dávky = plochá, stabilní hladina. Dlouhý</text><text x="294.0" y="876.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">interval a velké dávky = větší kolísání mezi vrcholem a údolím.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="903.4" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="909.4" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">5</text><text x="64.0" y="908.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Přetékající okraj</text><text x="294.0" y="908.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Kolísání je nebezpečné u léčiv s úzkým terapeutickým oknem — proto</text><text x="294.0" y="928.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">se u nich volí kratší interval.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="956.1" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="962.1" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="64.0" y="961.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Kumulační index</text><text x="294.0" y="961.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Poměr koncentrace v ustáleném stavu k té po první dávce; udává,</text><text x="294.0" y="981.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">kolikrát se hladina nahromadí.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1008.7" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1014.7" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">7</text><text x="64.0" y="1013.7" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Zúžený odtok</text><text x="294.0" y="1013.7" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Při renální insuficienci se krátí UDRŽOVACÍ dávka (závisí na</text><text x="294.0" y="1034.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">clearance), ale nasycovací zůstává stejná (závisí na Vd).</text><rect x="27.0" y="1060.4" width="846.0" height="62.5" rx="10" fill="#F7CFC4" opacity="0.42"/><path d="M30.3,1061.0 L867.8,1059.8 Q872.0,1059.7 871.8,1068.7 L876.4,1116.9 Q873.1,1122.7 869.5,1124.5 L33.0,1121.0 Q24.1,1126.0 26.1,1120.7 L25.9,1062.0 Q26.5,1057.2 30.6,1061.9" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><path d="M28.9,1056.6 L865.1,1062.8 Q873.3,1062.4 871.5,1065.7 L876.6,1121.0 Q871.7,1121.7 870.4,1122.0 L29.8,1126.6 Q27.7,1127.2 28.6,1119.4 L26.2,1062.9 Q27.6,1059.6 31.4,1062.4" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><text x="40.0" y="1081.4" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">⚠️</text><text x="66.0" y="1081.4" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">Nasycovací dávka se řídí distribučním objemem, udržovací clearance — proto se u renálního selhání</text><text x="66.0" y="1100.7" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">mění jen jedna z nich.</text></svg>

FÁZE — oxidace (hlavně cytochromy P450, nejvíc CYP3A4), redukce,</text><text x="294.0" y="743.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">hydrolýza. Vzniká reaktivnější metabolit s odhalenou funkční</text><text x="294.0" y="763.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">skupinou.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="790.9" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="796.9" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">2</text><text x="64.0" y="795.9" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Štítkovač II. fáze</text><text x="294.0" y="795.9" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">II. FÁZE — konjugace: glukuronidace, sulfatace, acetylace,</text><text x="294.0" y="816.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">methylace, vazba na glutathion. Produkt je velký, polární a snadno</text><text x="294.0" y="836.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">vyloučitelný.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="863.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="869.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">3</text><text x="64.0" y="868.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Kapka vody</text><text x="294.0" y="868.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Smyslem je změnit lipofilní látku na hydrofilní — jinak by se v</text><text x="294.0" y="889.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">ledvinách stále zpětně vstřebávala.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="916.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="922.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">4</text><text x="64.0" y="921.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Jiskra aktivace</text><text x="294.0" y="921.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">PROLÉČIVO se aktivuje až metabolismem: kodein → morfin (CYP2D6),</text><text x="294.0" y="941.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">enalapril → enalaprilát, cyklofosfamid, klopidogrel.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="969.2" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="975.2" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">5</text><text x="64.0" y="974.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Toxický metabolit</text><text x="294.0" y="974.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Metabolismus může vytvořit i jed: paracetamol → NAPQI, methanol →</text><text x="294.0" y="994.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">kyselina mravenčí („letální syntéza“).</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1021.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1027.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="64.0" y="1026.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Novorozenec</text><text x="294.0" y="1026.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Nezralá glukuronidace u novorozence — odtud gray baby syndrom po</text><text x="294.0" y="1047.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">chloramfenikolu.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1074.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1080.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">7</text><text x="64.0" y="1079.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Jiná pracoviště</text><text x="294.0" y="1079.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Kromě jater i střevní stěna, plíce, ledviny a plazma (esterázy). U</text><text x="294.0" y="1099.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">starších klesá hlavně I. fáze, II. zůstává poměrně zachovaná.</text><rect x="27.0" y="1126.1" width="846.0" height="62.5" rx="10" fill="#F7CFC4" opacity="0.42"/><path d="M34.6,1126.4 L865.2,1126.2 Q873.8,1124.7 871.5,1132.8 L873.7,1181.2 Q876.2,1187.5 869.4,1187.7 L29.1,1192.7 Q25.8,1191.3 23.0,1184.6 L25.1,1127.8 Q26.7,1128.0 33.4,1123.9" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><path d="M34.6,1122.5 L871.3,1122.7 Q875.1,1126.8 871.8,1130.0 L875.2,1183.4 Q873.7,1188.6 868.8,1187.2 L31.3,1187.0 Q23.6,1189.5 28.2,1185.3 L25.0,1134.2 Q27.0,1125.0 31.1,1125.2" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><text x="40.0" y="1147.1" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">⚠️</text><text x="66.0" y="1147.1" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">Metabolit není vždy neúčinný — může být účinnější než původní látka, stejně toxický, nebo teprve</text><text x="66.0" y="1166.4" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">toxický. Proto se sleduje osud metabolitu, ne jen léčiva.</text></svg>

vstřebané ze střeva projde portální žílou JÁTRY dřív, než se</text><text x="294.0" y="743.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">dostane do systémového oběhu — font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Silný first-pass mají nitroglycerin, propranolol, morfin,</text><text x="294.0" y="795.9" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">verapamil, lidokain — proto se nitroglycerin podává sublingválně a</text><text x="294.0" y="816.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">lidokain se font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">ENTEROHEPATÁLNÍ OBĚH: látka se vyloučí žlučí, ve střevě se uvolní a</text><text x="294.0" y="868.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">znovu vstřebá — prodlužuje účinek (kontraceptiva; proto mohou</text><text x="294.0" y="889.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">antibiotika jejich účinnost snížit).</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="916.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="922.5" font-size="17" y="921.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">U léčiv s VYSOKOU jaterní extrakcí limituje eliminaci PRŮTOK játry</text><text x="294.0" y="941.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">— při srdečním selhání a šoku hladiny stoupají.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="969.2" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="975.2" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">5</text><text x="64.0" y="974.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Enzymová dílna</text><text x="294.0" y="974.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">U NÍZKÉ extrakce rozhoduje enzymatická kapacita a vazba na</text><text x="294.0" y="994.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">bílkoviny, nikoli průtok.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1021.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1027.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="64.0" y="1026.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Objízdná trasa</text><text x="294.0" y="1026.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Játra obcházejí sublingvální, bukální, transdermální a parenterální</text><text x="294.0" y="1047.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">podání; rektální jen zčásti.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1074.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1080.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">7</text><text x="64.0" y="1079.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Nízký albumin</text><text x="294.0" y="1079.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Při jaterním selhání klesá metabolismus i tvorba albuminu, roste</text><text x="294.0" y="1099.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">volná frakce a zkratový oběh obchází játra — dávky se paroxetin)</text><text x="294.0" y="1034.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">SNÍŽÍ účinek kodeinu a klopidogrelu, protože zabrání jejich</text><text x="294.0" ED50 =</text><text x="294.0" y="770.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">dávka účinná u poloviny, TD50 = toxická u poloviny, LD50 = smrtelná</text><text x="294.0" y="791.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">pro polovinu.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="818.4" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="824.4" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">3</text><text x="64.0" y="823.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Fonendoskop a odběr</text><text x="294.0" y="823.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Úzký index mají digoxin, warfarin, theofylin, lithium, fenytoin,</text><text x="294.0" y="843.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">aminoglykosidy, cyklosporin — u nich se MĚŘÍ plazmatické hladiny.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="871.1" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="877.1" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">4</text><text x="64.0" y="876.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Číslice NNT</text><text x="294.0" y="876.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">NNT — kolik pacientů je třeba léčit, aby se u jednoho zabránilo</text><text x="294.0" y="896.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">příhodě; nízké NNT = účinná léčba. Obdobně NNH pro poškození.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="923.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="929.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">5</text><text x="64.0" y="928.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Esovitá křivka</text><text x="294.0" y="928.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Vztah dávky a účinku je sigmoidní (v logaritmickém měřítku).</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="956.1" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="962.1" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="64.0" y="961.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Silák</text><text x="294.0" y="961.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">ÚČINNOST (efficacy) = jak vysokého maxima lék dosáhne.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="988.4" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="994.4" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">7</text><text x="64.0" y="993.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Malá tableta</text><text x="294.0" y="993.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">POTENCE = jak malá dávka k tomu stačí. Potentnější lék NENÍ lepší</text><text x="294.0" y="1013.7" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">lék — rozhoduje maximální účinek a bezpečnost.</text><rect x="27.0" y="1040.1" width="846.0" height="62.5" rx="10" fill="#F7CFC4" opacity="0.42"/><path d="M35.4,1036.3 L865.6,1038.4 Q875.0,1042.3 876.6,1045.7 L875.1,1094.9 Q871.0,1103.4 869.2,1103.6 L30.8,1104.2 Q26.8,1102.6 26.4,1094.5 L22.6,1047.6 Q27.4,1041.7 30.1,1040.4" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><path d="M29.4,1042.4 L866.8,1040.4 Q873.5,1040.6 876.8,1047.4 L876.5,1095.0 Q875.6,1105.5 868.8,1105.1 L33.2,1100.7 Q24.9,1105.9 25.8,1096.9 L26.2,1044.9 Q22.8,1042.2 32.4,1039.6" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><text x="40.0" y="1061.1" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">⚠️</text><text x="66.0" y="1061.1" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">Riziko se vždy váží proti prospěchu: u onkologické léčby se přijímá terapeutický index, který by u</text><text x="66.0" y="1080.3" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">léku na rýmu byl nepřijatelný.</text></svg>

x="294.0" y="697.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Nezralá glukuronidace, vyšší podíl tělesné vody, nižší vazba na</text><text x="294.0" y="718.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">bílkoviny a nezralá glomerulární filtrace.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="745.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="751.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">2</text><text x="64.0" y="750.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Seniorka</text><text x="294.0" y="750.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Nižší glomerulární filtrace, nižší albumin, méně svaloviny a více</text><text x="294.0" y="770.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">tuku (lipofilní léčiva se hromadí), vyšší citlivost CNS.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="798.1" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="804.1" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">3</text><text x="64.0" y="803.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Ledvina a játra</text><text x="294.0" y="803.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Jaterní selhání snižuje metabolismus a tvorbu albuminu; renální</text><text x="294.0" y="823.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">insuficience zpomaluje vylučování. U obojího se dávky snižují.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="850.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="856.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">4</text><text x="64.0" y="855.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Šroubovice</text><text x="294.0" y="855.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Polymorfismus CYP2D6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, NAT2, TPMT rozhoduje, zda je</text><text x="294.0" y="876.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">člověk pomalý, nebo ultrarychlý metabolizátor.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="903.4" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="909.4" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">5</text><text x="64.0" y="908.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Talíř s jídlem</text><text x="294.0" y="908.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Jídlo mění vstřebávání (mléko a antacida váží tetracykliny),</text><text x="294.0" y="928.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">grapefruit inhibuje CYP3A4, kouření indukuje CYP1A2 (theofylin,</text><text x="294.0" y="949.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">klozapin, olanzapin).</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="976.4" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="982.4" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="64.0" y="981.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Těhotná</text><text x="294.0" y="981.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Roste objem distribuce a glomerulární filtrace, klesá albumin — a</text><text x="294.0" y="1001.7" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">přibývá otázka, co projde placentou.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1029.1" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1035.1" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">7</text><text x="64.0" y="1034.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Změněná citlivost</text><text x="294.0" y="1034.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Mění se i DYNAMIKA: u seniorů vyšší citlivost na benzodiazepiny a</text><text x="294.0" y="1054.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">opioidy, při hypokalemii vyšší toxicita digoxinu.</text><rect x="27.0" y="1080.7" width="846.0" height="62.5" rx="10" x="294.0" y="697.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">FARMAKOKINETICKÉ interakce: vstřebávání (antacida a železo váží</text><text x="294.0" y="718.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">tetracykliny a chinolony), vazba na bílkoviny, metabolismus</text><text x="294.0" y="738.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">(inhibice a indukce CYP450), vylučování (probenecid a penicilin).</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="765.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="771.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">2</text><text x="64.0" y="770.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Lano dynamické</text><text x="294.0" y="770.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">FARMAKODYNAMICKÉ interakce: synergie (alkohol + benzodiazepiny =</text><text x="294.0" y="791.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">útlum dechu; ACE inhibitor + kalium šetřící diuretikum =</text><text x="294.0" y="811.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">hyperkalemie) nebo antagonismus (β-blokátor ruší β2-agonistu u</text><text x="294.0" y="831.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">astmatu).</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="859.1" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="865.1" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">3</text><text x="64.0" y="864.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Grapefruit</text><text x="294.0" y="864.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Inhibuje střevní CYP3A4 → prudce zvýší hladinu statinů, blokátorů</text><text x="294.0" y="884.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">kalciových kanálů a imunosupresiv.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="911.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="917.8" font-size="17" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Silný induktor CYP3A4 a P-glykoproteinu → sníží účinnost</text><text x="294.0" y="937.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">kontracepce, warfarinu, cyklosporinu, digoxinu a antiretrovirotik.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="964.4" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="970.4" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">5</text><text x="64.0" y="969.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Warfarin uprostřed</text><text x="294.0" y="969.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Nejrizikovější dvojice: warfarin s čímkoli · statin s makrolidem</text><text x="294.0" y="989.7" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">nebo azolem · NSA s antikoagulanciem.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1017.1" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1023.1" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="64.0" y="1022.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Prodloužené QT</text><text x="294.0" y="1022.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Látky prodlužující QT se sčítají: antiarytmika III. třídy,</text><text x="294.0" y="1042.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">makrolidy, chinolony, antipsychotika, ondansetron.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1069.7" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1075.7" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">7</text><text x="64.0" y="1074.7" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Nákupní taška</text><text x="294.0" y="1074.7" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Nejvíc interakcí nevzniká z léků na předpis, ale z toho, co pacient</text><text x="294.0" y="1095.0" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">nehlásí: volně prodejná NSA, doplňky stravy a bylinky.</text><rect x="27.0" y="1121.4" width="846.0" height="62.5" rx="10" fill="#F7CFC4" opacity="0.42"/><path fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">3</text><text x="64.0" y="828.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Obrácená cedule</text><text x="294.0" y="828.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">U PROLÉČIVA je to naopak: ultrarychlý CYP2D6 vytvoří z kodeinu</text><text x="294.0" y="848.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">nebezpečně mnoho morfinu, pomalý nemá z kodeinu ani z klopidogrelu</text><text x="294.0" y="868.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">žádný účinek.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="896.2" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="902.2" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">4</text><text x="64.0" y="901.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Laboratorní výsledek</text><text x="294.0" y="901.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Testuje se HLA-B*5701 před abakavirem, HLA-B*5801 před</text><text x="294.0" y="921.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">allopurinolem, TPMT před azathioprinem a 6-merkaptopurinem, G6PD</text><text x="294.0" y="941.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">před primachinem a sulfonamidy.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="969.2" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="975.2" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">5</text><text x="64.0" y="974.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Prasklý erytrocyt</text><text x="294.0" y="974.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Deficit G6PD vede k HEMOLÝZE po primachinu, sulfonamidech a</text><text x="294.0" y="994.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">nitrofurantoinu.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1021.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1027.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="64.0" y="1026.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Horečka na sále</text><text x="294.0" y="1026.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">MALIGNÍ HYPERTERMIE po sukcinylcholinu a halogenovaných</text><text x="294.0" y="1047.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">anesteticích — geneticky podmíněná idiosynkrazie; antidotem</text><text x="294.0" y="1067.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">dantrolen.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1094.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1100.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">NAT2 určuje rychlost acetylace izoniazidu — pomalí acetylátoři mají</text><text x="294.0" y="1120.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">REZISTENCE je vlastnost MIKROORGANISMU, ne pacienta — primární</text><text x="294.0" y="941.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">(přirozená) nebo získaná (mutace, přenos plazmidu). Nepleť si ji s</text><text x="294.0" y="962.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">tolerancí.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="989.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stejným mechanismem —</text><text x="294.0" y="1014.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">alkohol, benzodiazepiny a barbituráty; morfin a ostatní y="718.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">chromozomové aberace, změny počtu chromozomů. V zárodečných buňkách</text><text x="294.0" y="738.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">se přenáší na potomstvo.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="765.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="771.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">2</text><text x="64.0" y="770.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Nádor</text><text x="294.0" y="770.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">KARCINOGENEZE má fáze INICIACE (nevratné poškození DNA), PROMOCE</text><text x="294.0" y="791.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">(podpora množení poškozeného klonu) a PROGRESE.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="818.4" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="824.4" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">3</text><text x="64.0" y="823.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Dlouhé přesýpací hodiny</text><text x="294.0" y="823.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Latence je roky až desetiletí — proto se karcinogenita odhalí až po</text><text x="294.0" y="843.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">letech užívání a žádná registrační studie ji nezachytí.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="871.1" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="877.1" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">4</text><text x="64.0" y="876.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Amesův test</text><text x="294.0" y="876.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Testuje se předklinicky: Amesův test (mutagenita na bakteriích),</text><text x="294.0" y="896.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">testy chromozomových aberací, dlouhodobé studie na hlodavcích.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="923.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="929.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">5</text><text x="64.0" y="928.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Cytostatikum</text><text x="294.0" y="928.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Alkylační látky vyvolávají sekundární leukemie — lék na nádor</text><text x="294.0" y="949.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">zvyšuje riziko nádoru druhého.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="976.4" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="982.4" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="64.0" y="981.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Imunosuprese</text><text x="294.0" y="981.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Imunosupresiva zvyšují výskyt lymfomů a kožních nádorů.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1008.7" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1014.7" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">7</text><text x="64.0" y="1013.7" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Cigareta</text><text x="294.0" y="1013.7" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Genotoxické karcinogeny nemají bezpečnou dávku; negenotoxické</text><text x="294.0" y="1034.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">(hormonální, imunosupresivní) působí nepřímo — estrogeny bez</text><text x="294.0" y="1054.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">gestagenu a karcinom endometria.</text><rect x="27.0" y="1080.7" width="846.0" height="62.5" rx="10" fill="#F7CFC4" opacity="0.42"/><path d="M33.3,1078.6 L868.0,1077.2 Q874.9,1082.0 876.4,1088.6 L874.5,1137.9 poměr rizika a prospěchu,</text><text x="66.0" y="1121.0" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">který se váží u každého pacienta zvlášť.</text></svg>

fenytoin, metotrexát, mykofenolát, ACE inhibitory a</text><text x="294.0" y="868.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">sartany, tetracykliny, živé vakcíny, text-anchor="middle">4</text><text x="64.0" y="901.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Rostoucí plod</text><text x="294.0" y="901.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Od 9. týdne vznikají FUNKČNÍ poruchy a poruchy růstu: ACE</text><text x="294.0" y="921.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">inhibitory poškozují ledviny plodu, NSA předčasně uzavírají ductus</text><text x="294.0" y="941.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">arteriosus, tetracykliny barví zuby.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="969.2" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="975.2" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">5</text><text x="64.0" y="974.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Kojení</text><text x="294.0" y="974.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Do mléka přechází nejspíš látka lipofilní, málo vázaná na bílkoviny</text><text x="294.0" y="994.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">a zásaditá. Podává se ihned PO kojení. Kontraindikovány jsou</text><text x="294.0" y="1014.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">cytostatika, radiofarmaka, lithium, amiodaron.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1042.1" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1048.1" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="64.0" y="1047.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Váhy rizika</text><text x="294.0" y="1047.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Neléčená nemoc matky (epilepsie, astma, těžká deprese, infekce)</text><text x="294.0" y="1067.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">ohrožuje plod často víc než lék — neléčí se „nulovým rizikem“, ale</text><text x="294.0" y="1087.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">poměrem rizika a prospěchu.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1115.1" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1121.1" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">7</text><text x="64.0" y="1120.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Kyselina listová</text><text x="294.0" y="1120.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Podává se preventivně už před početím jako prevence rozštěpů</text><text x="294.0" y="1140.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">neurální trubice; u žen na antiepilepticích ve vyšší dávce.</text><rect x="27.0" y="1166.8" width="846.0" height="62.5" rx="10" fill="#F7CFC4" opacity="0.42"/><path d="M32.3,1169.1 L871.1,1169.0 Q870.7,1167.9 872.1,1169.6 L872.3,1225.6 Q871.6,1231.1 869.2,1233.0 L28.7,1229.6 Q26.5,1227.9 23.3,1223.0 L28.7,1172.4 Q24.9,1162.5 30.5,1167.2" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><path d="M30.4,1164.6 L866.1,1163.7 Q873.7,1164.2 870.9,1173.5 L873.5,1226.9 Q875.8,1232.2 865.9,1229.0 L31.2,1233.1 Q26.2,1232.4 28.0,1223.6 L29.3,1172.9 Q28.3,1164.0 34.8,1165.1" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><text x="40.0" y="1187.8" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">⚠️</text><text x="66.0" y="1187.8" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">Bezpečnost v graviditě se nedá odvodit z toho, že je lék volně prodejný — NSA jsou ve třetím</text><text x="66.0" y="1207.1" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">trimestru kontraindikované, přestože je má doma každý.</text></svg>

font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">generika; dokládá se srovnatelná kvalita, účinnost a bezpečnost, ne</text><text x="294.0" y="969.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">pouhá bioekvivalence.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="996.7" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1002.7" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="64.0" y="1001.7" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Latentní tuberkulóza</text><text x="294.0" y="1001.7" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Před anti-TNF-α je nutné vyloučit latentní tuberkulózu a hepatitidu</text><text x="294.0" y="1022.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">B — hrozí reaktivace.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1049.4" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Protilátky proti léku</text><text x="294.0" y="1054.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Imunogenicita — tvorba neutralizujících protilátek proti léku,</text><text x="294.0" y="1074.7" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">které ho časem přestanou nechat účinkovat. Dále infuzní a</text><text x="294.0" y="1095.0" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">hypersenzitivní reakce.</text><rect x="27.0" y="1121.4" width="846.0" height="62.5" rx="10" fill="#F7CFC4" opacity="0.42"/><path d="M32.1,1120.0 L871.0,1121.8 Q874.4,1119.9 872.2,1125.5 L872.7,1181.7 Q877.2,1187.3 869.1,1182.2 L33.9,1182.1 Q23.3,1186.4 28.6,1175.6 L27.5,1124.2 Q27.7,1117.6 30.0,1117.9" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><path d="M30.1,1117.6 L865.9,1117.9 Q875.5,1117.0 874.8,1123.6 L874.1,1176.6 Q875.6,1184.6 869.9,1183.9 L30.8,1184.4 Q25.3,1182.6 27.2,1178.7 L24.3,1124.3 Q22.7,1118.3 35.3,1120.2" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><text x="40.0" y="1142.4" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">⚠️</text><text x="66.0" y="1142.4" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">Inhibitory kontrolních bodů (nivolumab, pembrolizumab) působí opačně než imunosupresiva — uvolňují</text><text x="66.0" y="1161.6" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">brzdu imunity, a proto jejich nežádoucí účinky vypadají jako autoimunitní choroby.</text></svg>
