font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">DONEPEZIL, rivastigmin a galantamin jsou terciární aminy — do CNS</text><text x="294.0" y="868.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">pronikají, u Alzheimerovy choroby. Fysostigmin je antidotem</text><text x="294.0" y="889.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">anticholinergního deliria.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="916.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="922.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">4</text><text x="64.0" y="921.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Postřikovač</text><text x="294.0" y="921.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">ORGANOFOSFÁTY (insekticidy, bojové látky) vážou enzym NEVRATNĚ —</text><text x="294.0" y="941.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">cholinergní krize: mióza, bronchorea, bronchospasmus, bradykardie,</text><text x="294.0" y="962.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">křeče, obrna dýchacích svalů.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="989.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="995.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">5</text><text x="64.0" y="994.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Atropin</text><text x="294.0" y="994.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Antidotum I: ATROPIN — blokuje muskarinové účinky.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1021.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1027.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="64.0" y="1026.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Pralidoxim</text><text x="294.0" y="1026.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Antidotum II: PRALIDOXIM — reaktivuje enzym, dokud nedojde ke</text><text x="294.0" y="1047.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">„stárnutí“ vazby.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1074.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1080.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">7</text><text x="64.0" y="1079.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Edrofonium</text><text x="294.0" y="1079.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Edrofonium má velmi krátký účinek (dříve diagnostický test u</text><text x="294.0" y="1099.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">myasthenia gravis).</text><rect x="27.0" y="1126.1" width="846.0" height="62.5" rx="10" fill="#F7CFC4" opacity="0.42"/><path d="M33.8,1123.4 L870.8,1123.9 Q873.2,1127.2 organofosfátovou otravu nevyřeší — neúčinkuje na nikotinové receptory, a tedy ani na</text><text x="66.0" y="1166.4" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">obrnu dýchacích svalů. Kontraindikací je</text><text x="294.0" y="848.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">GLAUKOM S UZAVŘENÝM ÚHLEM — rozšířená duhovka uzavře komorový úhel.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="875.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="881.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">4</text><text x="64.0" y="880.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Splašené srdce</text><text x="294.0" y="880.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Blokáda M2 → tachykardie. Atropin se proto podává u bradykardie a v</text><text x="294.0" y="901.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">premedikaci.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="928.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="934.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">5</text><text x="64.0" y="933.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Zamčený záchod</text><text x="294.0" y="933.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Retence moči (pozor u hyperplazie prostaty) a zácpa až paralytický</text><text x="294.0" y="953.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">ileus.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="981.2" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="987.2" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="64.0" y="986.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Šílený kloboučník</text><text x="294.0" y="986.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Centrální anticholinergní syndrom — neklid, zmatenost, delirium.</text><text x="294.0" y="1006.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Antidotem FYSOSTIGMIN (terciární amin, projde do CNS).</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1033.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1039.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">7</text><text x="64.0" y="1038.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Rozepnuté plíce</text><text x="294.0" y="1038.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Ipratropium a tiotropium inhalačně u CHOPN a astmatu. Dále</text><text x="294.0" y="1059.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">butylskopolamin (spasmolytikum), tropikamid (oční vyšetření),</text><text x="294.0" y="1079.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">biperiden, oxybutynin a solifenacin.</text><rect x="27.0" y="1105.8" width="846.0" height="62.5" rx="10" fill="#F7CFC4" opacity="0.42"/><path d="M34.4,1105.8 L868.5,1104.4 Q875.9,1104.5 877.3,1109.6 L871.1,1160.5 Q876.8,1168.4 867.3,1167.1 L33.5,1167.7 Q28.2,1168.8 28.1,1166.2 L27.4,1108.6 Q26.2,1105.6 31.7,1105.8" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><path d="M34.5,1103.4 L866.2,1103.9 Q876.5,1101.5 875.2,1112.1 L874.5,1162.0 Q876.4,1172.4 866.8,1170.4 L31.0,1166.6 Q25.0,1172.2 28.3,1163.3 L25.2,1112.2 Q28.2,1105.1 29.5,1105.9" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><text x="40.0" y="1126.8" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">⚠️</text><text x="66.0" y="1126.8" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">Butylskopolamin je KVARTÉRNÍ amin — neprojde do CNS, takže neseduje ani nevyvolá delirium. Atropin a</text><text x="66.0" y="1146.1" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">skopolamin (terciární) ano.</text></svg>

uroselektivní (α1A) — uvolní hladký</text><text x="294.0" y="848.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">sval prostaty a hrdla měchýře, tlak ovlivní text-anchor="middle">4</text><text x="64.0" y="880.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Retrográdní ejakulace</text><text x="294.0" y="880.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Typický nežádoucí účinek tamsulosinu.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="908.2" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" duhovka</text><text x="294.0" y="913.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">IFIS — intraoperative floppy iris syndrome; před operací katarakty</text><text x="294.0" feochromocytomu se nikdy nezačíná β-blokátorem — nebrzděná</text><text x="294.0" y="1038.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">α-stimulace by vyvolala hypertenzní DEPOLARIZUJÍCÍ — chová se jako acetylcholin,</text><text x="294.0" y="743.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">který se nerozkládá: nejprve receptor trvale Působí 5–10 minut.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="790.9" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="796.9" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">2</text><text x="64.0" y="795.9" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Nelze zvrátit</text><text x="294.0" y="795.9" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Depolarizující blok NELZE zvrátit neostigminem — ten by ho</text><text x="294.0" y="816.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">prohloubil.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="843.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="849.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">NEDEPOLARIZUJÍCÍ (rokuronium, vekuronium, atrakurium,</text><text x="294.0" y="868.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">cisatrakurium) jsou kompetitivní antagonisté nikotinového receptoru</text><text x="294.0" y="889.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">— sval ochrne bez fascikulací.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="916.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="922.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">4</text><text x="64.0" y="921.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Sugammadex</text><text x="294.0" y="921.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Nedepolarizující blok lze zvrátit neostigminem, u rokuronia</text><text x="294.0" y="941.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">specificky SUGAMMADEXEM.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="969.2" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="975.2" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">5</text><text x="64.0" y="974.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Maligní hypertermie</text><text x="294.0" y="974.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Vzácná geneticky podmíněná reakce na sukcinylcholin a inhalační</text><text x="294.0" y="994.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">anestetika: prudký vzestup teploty, rigidita, acidóza. Antidotem</text><text x="294.0" y="1014.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">DANTROLEN.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1042.1" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1048.1" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="64.0" y="1047.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Hyperkalemie</text><text x="294.0" y="1047.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Sukcinylcholin uvolní draslík — nebezpečné u popálenin, polytraumat</text><text x="294.0" y="1067.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">a neuromuskulárních chorob. Dále bolest svalů, vzestup nitroočního</text><text x="294.0" y="1087.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">tlaku, prodloužená apnoe při atypické pseudocholinesteráze.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1115.1" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1121.1" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">7</text><text x="64.0" y="1120.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Baklofen</text><text x="294.0" y="1120.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Centrální myorelaxancia: baklofen (agonista GABA-B), tizanidin,</text><text x="294.0" y="1140.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">tolperison — na spasticitu, nikoli k anestezii.</text><rect x="27.0" y="1166.8" width="846.0" height="62.5" rx="10" fill="#F7CFC4" opacity="0.42"/><path d="M35.0,1168.8 L870.3,1165.1 Q872.6,1165.2 872.6,1171.5 L874.3,1223.8 Q875.5,1229.0 869.0,1227.1 L30.3,1230.4 Q26.1,1227.2 27.9,1227.3 L24.6,1175.0 Q28.4,1163.7 32.3,1167.1" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><path d="M33.9,1162.9 L866.9,1167.8 Q875.8,1165.8 876.8,1172.5 L873.4,1227.4 Q876.9,1232.7 868.4,1232.5 L35.0,1233.6 Q26.5,1231.2 24.2,1227.4 L23.9,1173.2 Q26.6,1166.9 29.0,1163.2" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><text x="40.0" y="1187.8" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">⚠️</text><text x="66.0" y="1187.8" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">Myorelaxans netlumí vědomí ani bolest — pacient musí být zároveň uspán a analgetizován, jinak je</text><text x="66.0" y="1207.1" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">ochrnutý při vědomí.</text></svg>

prostředí zánětu převáží ionizovaná forma, která neprojde</text><text x="294.0" y="795.9" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">membránou k místu účinku — proto se v zaníceném terénu často</text><text x="294.0" y="816.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">nepodaří umrtvit.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="843.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">S adrenalinem</text><text x="294.0" y="848.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Vazokonstrikce prodlouží účinek, sníží krvácení a systémovou</text><text x="294.0" y="868.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">toxicitu. NEPODÁVAT do akrálních částí (prsty, nos, ucho) — riziko</text><text x="294.0" y="889.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">ischemie.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="916.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="922.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">4</text><text x="64.0" y="921.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Brnění kolem úst</text><text x="294.0" y="921.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Systémová toxicita začíná v CNS: kovová chuť, brnění kolem úst,</text><text x="294.0" y="941.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">hučení, závrať, křeče — a TEPRVE PAK přijde kardiotoxicita.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="969.2" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="975.2" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">5</text><text x="64.0" y="974.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Bupivakain</text><text x="294.0" y="974.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Bupivakain je nejkardiotoxičtější; léčbou systémové toxicity je</text><text x="294.0" y="994.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">lipidová emulze.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1021.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1027.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="64.0" y="1026.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Estery a amidy</text><text x="294.0" y="1026.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">ESTERY (prokain, benzokain, tetrakain) štěpí plazmatické esterázy,</text><text x="294.0" y="1047.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">častější alergie (metabolit PABA). AMIDY (lidokain, mepivakain,</text><text x="294.0" y="1067.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">artikain, bupivakain, prilokain) se metabolizují v játrech, alergie</text><text x="294.0" y="1087.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">vzácná.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1115.1" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1121.1" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">7</text><text x="64.0" y="1120.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Modrá krev</text><text x="294.0" y="1120.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Prilokain a benzokain mohou vyvolat methemoglobinemii — antidotem</text><text x="294.0" y="1140.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">methylenová modř.</text><rect x="27.0" y="1166.8" width="846.0" height="62.5" rx="10" fill="#F7CFC4" opacity="0.42"/><path d="M33.9,1164.6 L865.7,1166.2 Q875.1,1167.8 872.7,1170.4 L874.4,1225.8 Q874.0,1230.6 866.8,1232.4 L33.0,1233.4 Q25.7,1233.1 29.2,1226.7 L24.8,1172.7 Q25.8,1165.8 31.2,1165.4" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><path d="M33.3,1164.4 L865.1,1163.0 Q871.8,1168.8 873.7,1171.3 L874.8,1227.3 Q870.7,1231.4 870.6,1231.0 L30.0,1231.3 Q27.7,1232.1 26.3,1225.7 L28.7,1170.7 Q24.4,1165.9 33.2,1164.2" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><text x="40.0" y="1187.8" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">⚠️</text><text x="66.0" y="1187.8" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">Nejdřív vypadne bolest a teplo, pak dotek a nakonec motorika — tenká nemyelinizovaná vlákna se</text><text x="66.0" y="1207.1" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">blokují první. Lidokain je zároveň antiarytmikum třídy Ib.</text></svg>

font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">MAC — minimální alveolární koncentrace, při níž se 50 % pacientů</text><text x="294.0" y="718.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">nepohne po kožním řezu; je mírou potence. NÍZKÉ MAC = VYSOKÁ</text><text x="294.0" y="738.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">potence.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="765.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="771.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">2</text><text x="64.0" y="770.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Klesající MAC</text><text x="294.0" y="770.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">MAC klesá s věkem, v graviditě a při současném podání opioidů.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="798.1" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="804.1" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">3</text><text x="64.0" y="803.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Rychlá pára</text><text x="294.0" y="803.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Rychlost nástupu určuje rozpustnost v krvi: čím nižší, tím</text><text x="294.0" y="823.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">rychlejší nástup i probuzení. Desfluran a sevofluran nastupují</text><text x="294.0" y="843.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">rychle, halothan pomalu.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="871.1" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="877.1" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">4</text><text x="64.0" y="876.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Maligní hypertermie</text><text x="294.0" y="876.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Halogenovaná anestetika (sevofluran, desfluran, isofluran) mohou</text><text x="294.0" y="896.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">spolu se sukcinylcholinem vyvolat malignitní hypertermii —</text><text x="294.0" y="916.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">antidotem DANTROLEN.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="944.1" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="950.1" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">5</text><text x="64.0" y="949.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Halothan</text><text x="294.0" y="949.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Halothan navíc hepatotoxicita — dnes se prakticky nepoužívá.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="976.4" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="982.4" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="64.0" y="981.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Rajský plyn</text><text x="294.0" y="981.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Oxid dusný (N2O) má výbornou ANALGEZII, ale slabý anestetický</text><text x="294.0" y="1001.7" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">účinek — jen jako doplněk. Inaktivuje vitamin B12 a difunduje do</text><text x="294.0" y="1022.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">uzavřených dutin.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1049.4" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1055.4" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">7</text><text x="64.0" y="1054.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Sevofluran u dětí</text><text x="294.0" y="1054.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Sevofluran je pro dobrou snášenlivost dýchacími cestami vhodný k</text><text x="294.0" y="1074.7" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">úvodu do anestezie u dětí.</text><rect x="27.0" y="1101.0" width="846.0" height="62.5" rx="10" fill="#F7CFC4" opacity="0.42"/><path d="M32.8,1101.4 L867.9,1101.5 Q870.8,1097.9 872.7,1103.6 L874.5,1162.0 Q872.5,1166.6 871.3,1165.1 L28.9,1163.9 Q25.4,1166.5 23.6,1160.5 L25.0,1104.8 Q23.3,1102.1 30.2,1098.0" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><path d="M32.6,1100.3 L870.1,1099.2 Q874.6,1099.2 877.3,1104.4 L876.2,1161.5 Q871.4,1164.3 866.1,1163.8 L31.9,1163.2 Q28.9,1167.2 28.4,1158.3 L26.7,1109.3 Q29.1,1099.3 30.5,1099.4" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><text x="40.0" y="1122.0" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">⚠️</text><text x="66.0" y="1122.0" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">Inhalační anestetika snižují krevní tlak a tlumí dýchání — proto se vedou v kombinaci s dalšími</text><text x="66.0" y="1141.3" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">složkami anestezie, ne samostatně ve vysoké dávce.</text></svg>

propofolu</text><text x="294.0" y="697.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">PROPOFOL — nejužívanější, rychlý nástup i odeznění, antiemetický</text><text x="294.0" y="718.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">účinek. Nežádoucí: pokles krevního tlaku, útlum dechu, bolest při</text><text x="294.0" y="738.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">injekci; při dlouhé vysokodávkované infuzi propofolový infuzní</text><text x="294.0" y="758.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">syndrom.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="786.1" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="792.1" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">2</text><text x="64.0" y="791.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Ketamin</text><text x="294.0" y="791.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">KETAMIN je antagonista NMDA — disociativní anestezie se silnou</text><text x="294.0" y="811.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">analgezií. Na rozdíl od ostatních krevní tlak NEKLESÁ (stoupá) a</text><text x="294.0" y="831.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">dechová aktivita se zachovává — proto se hodí v šoku a v</text><text x="294.0" y="852.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">přednemocniční péči.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="879.4" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="885.4" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">3</text><text x="64.0" y="884.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Halucinace při probouzení</text><text x="294.0" y="884.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Ketamin působí halucinace a neklid při probouzení — tlumí je</text><text x="294.0" y="904.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">benzodiazepin. Esketamin se používá u farmakorezistentní deprese.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="932.1" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="938.1" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">4</text><text x="64.0" y="937.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Etomidát</text><text x="294.0" y="937.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">ETOMIDÁT je oběhově velmi stabilní — vhodný u kardiaka; tlumí ale</text><text x="294.0" y="957.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">syntézu kortizolu, proto se nepodává v infuzi.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="984.7" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="990.7" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">5</text><text x="64.0" y="989.7" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Thiopental</text><text x="294.0" y="989.7" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">THIOPENTAL — účinek končí REDISTRIBUCÍ do svalu a tuku, nikoli</text><text x="294.0" y="1010.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">eliminací; pacient se probudí rychle, ale látka v těle přetrvává a</text><text x="294.0" y="1030.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">při opakovaném podání se kumuluje.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1057.7" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1063.7" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="64.0" y="1062.7" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Opioid</text><text x="294.0" y="1062.7" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Anestezie se vede kombinací: hypnotikum + analgetikum (opioid) +</text><text x="294.0" y="1083.0" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">myorelaxans.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1110.4" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1116.4" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">7</text><text x="64.0" y="1115.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Tři složky</text><text x="294.0" y="1115.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Jedna látka nezvládne všechny tři složky současně — proto se</text><text x="294.0" y="1135.7" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">anestezie vždy skládá.</text><rect x="27.0" y="1162.0" width="846.0" height="62.5" rx="10" fill="#F7CFC4" opacity="0.42"/><path d="M29.9,1162.7 L870.1,1157.7 Q871.4,1163.1 872.7,1169.2 L871.3,1219.3 Q872.6,1224.1 869.0,1227.6 L33.5,1225.7 Q23.9,1223.0 29.0,1220.7 L24.3,1168.9 Q26.0,1158.9 33.9,1161.3" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><path d="M32.8,1159.7 L867.5,1159.0 Q874.1,1161.2 874.0,1167.1 L872.4,1220.1 opacity="0.8"/><text x="40.0" y="1183.0" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">⚠️</text><text x="66.0" y="1183.0" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">Ketamin je výjimkou z většiny pravidel o intravenózních anestetikách — proto se u něj vyplatí</text><text x="66.0" y="1202.3" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">pamatovat si právě to, čím se liší.</text></svg>

font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Nežádoucí: amnézie a PARASOMNIE — jízda a jedení ve spánku.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="875.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="881.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">4</text><text x="64.0" y="880.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Pád u postele</text><text x="294.0" y="880.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">U seniorů riziko pádů a zmatenosti — patří na seznam nevhodných</text><text x="294.0" y="901.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">léčiv.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="928.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="934.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">5</text><text x="64.0" y="933.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Melatonin</text><text x="294.0" y="933.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Melatonin a agonisté melatoninových receptorů upravují cirkadiánní</text><text x="294.0" y="953.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">rytmus; bezpečné a nenávykové, ale slabší.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="981.2" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="987.2" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="64.0" y="986.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Rebound nespavost</text><text x="294.0" y="986.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Podávat co nejkratší dobu — po vysazení hrozí rebound nespavost.</text><text x="294.0" y="1006.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Základem léčby je spánková hygiena a kognitivně-behaviorální</text><text x="294.0" y="1026.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">terapie.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1054.1" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1060.1" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">7</text><text x="64.0" y="1059.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Barbiturát v trezoru</text><text x="294.0" y="1059.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Barbituráty se dnes jako hypnotika nepoužívají — úzké terapeutické</text><text x="294.0" y="1079.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">okno, útlum dechu bez stropu a silná indukce CYP450.</text><rect receptor — přestože chemicky</text><text x="66.0" y="1146.1" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">benzodiazepiny nejsou.</text></svg>

y="743.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">GABA-A; barbituráty zvyšují DOBU otevření a ve vysoké dávce kanál</text><text x="294.0" y="763.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">otevřou i bez GABA — proto nemají strop.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="790.9" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="796.9" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">2</text><text x="64.0" y="795.9" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Uklidněná postava</text><text x="294.0" y="795.9" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Čtyři účinky: anxiolytický, hypnotický, antikonvulzivní a centrálně</text><text x="294.0" epilepticus — diazepam, midazolam, lorazepam.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="875.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="881.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Samotný benzodiazepin dech tlumí málo, ale s ALKOHOLEM, OPIOIDY</text><text x="294.0" y="901.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">nebo Z-léčivy hrozí smrtelný útlum dechu — nejčastější příčina</text><text x="294.0" y="921.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="middle">5</text><text x="64.0" y="953.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Flumazenil</text><text x="294.0" y="953.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Kompetitivní antagonista; u chronického uživatele nebo při smíšené</text><text x="294.0" y="974.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">intoxikaci s tricykliky může vyvolat KŘEČE — podává se uvážlivě.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1001.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1007.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="64.0" y="1006.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Oxazepam u jaterní léze</text><text x="294.0" y="1006.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Krátce midazolam · středně alprazolam, oxazepam, lorazepam (u</text><text x="294.0" y="1026.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">jaterní léze — jen konjugace) · dlouze diazepam, klonazepam.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1054.1" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1060.1" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">7</text><text x="64.0" y="1059.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Odvykací stav</text><text x="294.0" y="1059.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Odvykací stav je nebezpečný (křeče, delirium) — vysazuje se pomalu.</text><rect x="27.0" y="1085.5" width="846.0" height="62.5" rx="10" fill="#F7CFC4" opacity="0.42"/><path d="M29.9,1081.7 L865.7,1084.5 krátkodobě působící a jen krátce — dlouhodobě působící benzodiazepiny</text><text x="66.0" y="1125.7" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">znamenají pády, zmatenost a y="718.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">fenytoin, karbamazepin, lamotrigin, lakosamid.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="745.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="751.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">2</text><text x="64.0" y="750.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Zbytnělé dásně</text><text x="294.0" y="750.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">FENYTOIN — saturační kinetika, gingivální hyperplazie, hirsutismus.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="777.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="783.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">3</text><text x="64.0" y="782.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Karbamazepin</text><text x="294.0" y="782.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Silný INDUKTOR CYP450 (sníží účinnost kontracepce a warfarinu),</text><text x="294.0" y="803.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">hyponatremie, agranulocytóza.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="830.4" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="836.4" font-size="17" y="835.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Benzodiazepiny, fenobarbital, valproát, tiagabin, vigabatrin.</text><text x="294.0" y="855.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Ethosuximid blokuje kalciové kanály typu T a je lékem volby u</text><text x="294.0" y="876.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">absencí.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="903.4" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="909.4" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">5</text><text x="64.0" y="908.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Těhotná</text><text x="294.0" y="908.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">VALPROÁT je nejsilnější teratogen mezi antiepileptiky (rozštěpy</text><text x="294.0" y="928.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">neurální trubice, poruchy vývoje, snížení IQ) — u žen ve fertilním</text><text x="294.0" y="949.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">věku jen výjimečně a se spolehlivou kontracepcí.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="976.4" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="982.4" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="64.0" y="981.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Vyrážka</text><text x="294.0" y="981.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">LAMOTRIGIN se musí titrovat velmi pomalu — jinak hrozí</text><text x="294.0" y="1001.7" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Stevensův–Johnsonův syndrom; riziko roste při současném valproátu,</text><text x="294.0" y="1022.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">který jeho hladinu zvyšuje.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1049.4" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1055.4" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">7</text><text x="64.0" y="1054.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Status epilepticus</text><text x="294.0" y="1054.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Lékem první volby je benzodiazepin, dále fenytoin nebo valproát</text><text x="294.0" y="1074.7" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">nitrožilně.</text><rect x="27.0" y="1101.0" width="846.0" height="62.5" rx="10" fill="#F7CFC4" opacity="0.42"/><path d="M31.5,1100.3 L869.9,1100.9 Q876.9,1097.9 872.9,1103.8 Q28.1,1098.1 35.2,1100.8" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><text x="40.0" y="1122.0" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">⚠️</text><text x="66.0" y="1122.0" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">Karbamazepin je induktor, valproát naopak inhibitor — proto jejich kombinace nefunguje intuitivně a</text><text x="66.0" y="1141.3" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">hladiny se musí sledovat.</text></svg>

fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Hlídač karbidopa</text><text x="294.0" y="775.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Kombinuje se s inhibitorem periferní dekarboxylázy (karbidopa,</text><text x="294.0" y="795.9" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">benserazid) — jinak by se rozložila v těle a způsobila fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Prodloužení účinku</text><text x="294.0" y="848.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Inhibitory COMT (entakapon) a MAO-B (selegilin, rasagilin)</text><text x="294.0" y="868.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">prodlouží účinek levodopy.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="896.2" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="902.2" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">4</text><text x="64.0" y="901.2" font-size="15.4" (wearing-off, on-off fenomén) a</text><text x="294.0" y="921.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">polékové dyskineze — proto se u mladších začíná agonisty dopaminu a</text><text x="294.0" y="941.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">levodopa se oddaluje.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="969.2" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="975.2" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">5</text><text x="64.0" y="974.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Automat</text><text x="294.0" y="974.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Agonisté dopaminu (pramipexol, ropinirol, rotigotin) — poruchy</text><text x="294.0" y="994.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">IMPULZIVNÍHO CHOVÁNÍ (hráčství, nakupování, hypersexualita) a náhlé</text><text x="294.0" y="1014.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">usnutí.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1042.1" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1048.1" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="64.0" y="1047.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Třes</text><text x="294.0" y="1047.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Anticholinergika (biperiden) pomáhají hlavně na třes, ale u</text><text x="294.0" y="1067.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">starších působí zmatenost. Amantadin tlumí dyskineze.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1094.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1100.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">7</text><text x="64.0" y="1099.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Metoklopramid</text><text x="294.0" y="1099.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Antipsychotika a metoklopramid blokují D2 a vyvolají polékový</text><text x="294.0" y="1120.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">parkinsonský syndrom — u parkinsonika se nepodávají.</text><rect x="27.0" y="1146.5" width="846.0" height="62.5" rx="10" fill="#F7CFC4" opacity="0.42"/><path d="M34.8,1144.2 L865.3,1142.3 Q874.2,1145.8 874.4,1152.9 L873.8,1202.6 Q871.6,1209.4 866.0,1211.3 L32.7,1211.2 Q26.5,1212.3 23.4,1203.1 L24.5,1150.4 Q26.1,1144.9 34.3,1148.8" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><path d="M34.3,1148.5 L870.5,1142.7 Q871.0,1147.2 872.0,1152.0 L872.7,1202.3 Q877.0,1209.6 864.9,1207.0 L32.2,1210.7 Q27.2,1207.8 25.2,1206.2 L23.9,1148.6 Q29.3,1147.5 28.7,1145.4" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><text x="40.0" y="1167.5" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">⚠️</text><text x="66.0" y="1167.5" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">Levodopa může u disponovaných vyvolat psychózu — léčba parkinsonismu a léčba psychózy jdou proti sobě</text><text x="66.0" y="1186.7" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">a musí se vyvažovat.</text></svg>

font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">2</text><text x="64.0" y="770.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Sucho v ústech</text><text x="294.0" y="770.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Blokáda muskarinových receptorů: sucho v ústech, rozmazané vidění,</text><text x="294.0" y="791.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">zácpa, retence moči, u seniorů zmatenost.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="818.4" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="824.4" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">3</text><text x="64.0" y="823.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Sedace</text><text x="294.0" y="823.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Blokáda H1: sedace a přírůstek hmotnosti.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="850.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="856.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">4</text><text x="64.0" y="855.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Pád při vstávání</text><text x="294.0" y="855.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Blokáda α1: ortostatická hypotenze a pády.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="883.1" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="889.1" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">5</text><text x="64.0" y="888.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Předávkování</text><text x="294.0" y="888.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Blokádou sodíkových kanálů arytmie, rozšíření QRS, křeče a kóma — u</text><text x="294.0" y="908.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">suicidálního pacienta se nepředepisují ve velkém balení.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="935.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="941.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="64.0" y="940.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Sýrový efekt</text><text x="294.0" y="940.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Ireverzibilní neselektivní IMAO (tranylcypromin) — při tyraminu v</text><text x="294.0" y="961.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">potravě HYPERTENZNÍ KRIZE. Moklobemid je reverzibilní selektivní</text><text x="294.0" y="981.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">inhibitor MAO-A, a proto bezpečnější.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1008.7" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1014.7" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">7</text><text x="64.0" y="1013.7" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Serotoninový syndrom</text><text x="294.0" y="1013.7" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Kombinace IMAO s SSRI, tramadolem nebo triptany — horečka,</text><text x="294.0" y="1034.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">rigidita, myoklonus, neklid; mezi IMAO a SSRI je nutná</text><text x="294.0" y="1054.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">několikatýdenní pauza.</text><rect x="27.0" y="1080.7" width="846.0" height="62.5" rx="10" fill="#F7CFC4" opacity="0.42"/><path d="M31.3,1083.0 L869.8,1078.8 Q873.8,1081.8 872.9,1084.7 L875.5,1139.8 Q875.2,1144.3 868.9,1146.0 L35.2,1142.5 Q25.4,1146.2 28.7,1135.7 L22.8,1083.4 Q26.3,1078.0 35.0,1081.8" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><path d="M31.3,1078.3 L868.0,1079.9 Q874.3,1078.2 875.0,1087.5 L872.1,1138.1 Q871.6,1144.9 869.6,1142.6 L32.8,1140.9 Q28.5,1145.8 28.9,1137.3 L28.4,1086.9 Q29.3,1077.5 29.0,1081.0" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><text x="40.0" y="1101.7" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">⚠️</text><text x="66.0" y="1101.7" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">Tricyklika se dnes používají hlavně u neuropatické bolesti a v profylaxi migrény — účinnost mají, ale</text><text x="66.0" y="1121.0" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">bezpečnostní profil je proti SSRI nevýhodný.</text></svg>

týdny, nežádoucí účinky hned — nejčastější důvod,</text><text x="294.0" y="816.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">proč pacient léčbu předčasně font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Velmi častá; dále nauzea, nespavost nebo útlum, hyponatremie u</text><text x="294.0" y="868.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">seniorů a na začátku zvýšení úzkosti.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="896.2" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="902.2" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">4</text><text x="64.0" y="901.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Serotoninový syndrom</text><text x="294.0" y="901.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Při kombinaci s IMAO, tramadolem, triptany, linezolidem nebo</text><text x="294.0" y="921.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">třezalkou: horečka, rigidita, myoklonus, průjem, neklid až kóma.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="948.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="954.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">5</text><text x="64.0" y="953.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Krvácení</text><text x="294.0" y="953.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">SSRI snižují vychytávání serotoninu i do destiček — spolu s NSA</text><text x="294.0" y="974.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">nebo antiagregancii roste riziko krvácení do trávicího traktu.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1001.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1007.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="64.0" y="1006.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Mirtazapin</text><text x="294.0" y="1006.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">SNRI: venlafaxin a duloxetin (i u diabetické neuropatie).</text><text x="294.0" y="1026.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Mirtazapin je sedativní a zvyšuje chuť k jídlu — vhodný u</text><text x="294.0" y="1047.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">nespavosti a kachexie. Bupropion pomáhá při odvykání kouření, ale</text><text x="294.0" y="1067.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">snižuje práh křečí.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1094.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1100.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">7</text><text x="64.0" y="1099.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Syndrom z vysazení</text><text x="294.0" y="1099.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">SSRI se nevysazují náhle (kromě fluoxetinu s dlouhým poločasem) —</text><text x="294.0" y="1120.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">závratě, „elektrické šoky“, úzkost, chřipkovité příznaky.</text><rect x="27.0" y="1146.5" width="846.0" height="62.5" rx="10" fill="#F7CFC4" opacity="0.42"/><path d="M30.2,1144.6 L865.2,1145.6 Q876.3,1143.3 873.0,1149.4 L875.6,1200.7 Q873.6,1211.8 866.7,1210.2 L31.0,1211.2 Q25.0,1211.1 23.1,1201.0 L23.0,1153.7 Q23.8,1145.8 34.0,1145.9" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><path d="M30.6,1145.6 L866.2,1147.6 Q877.1,1146.9 871.8,1152.1 L873.4,1203.7 Q872.2,1209.3 865.1,1206.8 L34.6,1211.1 Q22.9,1212.5 24.2,1201.4 L26.4,1150.1 Q27.2,1142.3 33.2,1147.7" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><text x="40.0" y="1167.5" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">⚠️</text><text x="66.0" y="1167.5" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">Fluoxetin a paroxetin jsou silné inhibitory CYP2D6 — sníží účinek kodeinu a tamoxifenu, což jsou obě</text><text x="66.0" y="1186.7" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">proléčiva.</text></svg>

sedace, útlum kašle — a ÚTLUM</text><text x="294.0" y="743.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">DECHOVÉHO CENTRA, který je hlavní příčinou smrti při předávkování.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="770.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="776.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">2</text><text x="64.0" y="775.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Špendlíková zornice</text><text x="294.0" y="775.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">MIÓZA je klíčovým příznakem otravy; triáda: útlum vědomí + útlum</text><text x="294.0" y="795.9" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">dechu + mióza. Tolerance na miózu nevzniká.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="823.2" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="829.2" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">3</text><text x="64.0" y="828.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Zácpa</text><text x="294.0" y="828.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Zpomalení peristaltiky přes periferní μ-receptory; tolerance</text><text x="294.0" y="848.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">prakticky nevzniká — laxativum se podává profylakticky po celou</text><text x="294.0" y="868.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">dobu léčby.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="896.2" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="902.2" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">4</text><text x="64.0" y="901.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Naloxon</text><text x="294.0" y="901.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Kompetitivní antagonista; působí KRÁTCE, proto je nutné opakované</text><text x="294.0" y="921.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">podání a sledování — jinak se útlum dechu vrátí. U závislého vyvolá</text><text x="294.0" y="941.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">odvykací stav.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="969.2" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="975.2" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">5</text><text x="64.0" y="974.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Nauzea</text><text x="294.0" y="974.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Stimulace area postrema — nauzea a zvracení; dále retence moči,</text><text x="294.0" y="994.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">svědění a uvolnění histaminu, biliární spasmus.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1021.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1027.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="64.0" y="1026.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Kodein</text><text x="294.0" y="1026.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Proléčivo aktivované CYP2D6 na morfin; používá se jako antitusikum.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1054.1" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1060.1" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">7</text><text x="64.0" y="1059.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Papaverin</text><text x="294.0" y="1059.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Papaverin je myotropní spasmolytikum, nikoli analgetikum. Thebain</text><text x="294.0" y="1079.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">je výchozí látkou pro polosyntetické opioidy.</text><rect x="27.0" y="1105.8" width="846.0" height="62.5" rx="10" fill="#F7CFC4" opacity="0.42"/><path d="M34.4,1106.6 L870.6,1104.3 Q874.5,1105.6 875.5,1114.2 L872.3,1161.9 Q872.1,1171.0 866.1,1169.0 L33.7,1172.3 Q26.1,1171.0 24.0,1160.4 L27.1,1107.9 Q28.2,1102.7 34.9,1102.9" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><path d="M29.4,1102.6 L870.3,1107.1 Q876.4,1108.2 875.7,1113.5 L872.8,1161.3 Q873.9,1168.5 870.1,1166.2 L32.2,1167.6 Q26.4,1167.4 23.5,1165.0 L23.6,1111.1 Q27.1,1107.5 31.9,1107.5" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><text x="40.0" y="1126.8" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">⚠️</text><text x="66.0" y="1126.8" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">U bolesti při kolice se morfin kombinuje se spasmolytikem, protože sám zvyšuje tonus hladkého svalu a</text><text x="66.0" y="1146.1" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">biliární spasmus může zhoršit.</text></svg>

agonista μ — má STROPOVÝ efekt</text><text x="294.0" y="743.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">(bezpečnější útlum dechu), ale vysokou afinitu: podaný na plného</text><text x="294.0" y="763.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">agonistu ho VYTĚSNÍ a vyvolá odvykací stav.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="790.9" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="796.9" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">2</text><text x="64.0" y="795.9" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Fentanyl</text><text x="294.0" y="795.9" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Asi 100× potentnější než morfin — transdermální náplast u chronické</text><text x="294.0" y="816.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">nádorové bolesti, i.v. v anestezii. Sufentanil a remifentanil jsou</text><text x="294.0" y="836.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">ještě silnější a kratší.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="863.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="869.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">3</text><text x="64.0" y="868.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Tramadol</text><text x="294.0" y="868.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Slabý opioidní agonista, který navíc blokuje zpětné vychytávání</text><text x="294.0" y="889.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">serotoninu a noradrenalinu — SNIŽUJE PRÁH KŘEČÍ a s SSRI hrozí</text><text x="294.0" y="909.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">serotoninový syndrom; je proléčivo aktivované CYP2D6.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="936.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="942.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">4</text><text x="64.0" y="941.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Metadon</text><text x="294.0" y="941.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Dlouhý a proměnlivý poločas — vhodný k substituci, ale hrozí</text><text x="294.0" y="962.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">kumulace a PRODLOUŽENÍ QT.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="989.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="995.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">5</text><text x="64.0" y="994.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Oxykodon s naloxonem</text><text x="294.0" y="994.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Oxykodon se často kombinuje s naloxonem proti zácpě; dále</text><text x="294.0" y="1014.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">piritramid a hydromorfon.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1042.1" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1048.1" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="64.0" y="1047.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Pethidin</text><text x="294.0" y="1047.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Metabolit norpethidin je neurotoxický — dnes se nedoporučuje.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1074.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1080.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">7</text><text x="64.0" y="1079.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Naltrexon</text><text x="294.0" y="1079.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Dlouhodobě působící antagonista v udržovací léčbě závislosti (i na</text><text x="294.0" y="1099.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">alkoholu); naloxon slouží akutně při předávkování.</text><rect x="27.0" y="1126.1" width="846.0" height="62.5" rx="10" fill="#F7CFC4" opacity="0.42"/><path d="M28.9,1126.4 L870.9,1122.4 Q872.0,1127.9 874.5,1132.8 L871.6,1183.8 Q877.1,1186.5 868.9,1192.2 L30.5,1191.5 Q27.5,1191.2 24.6,1186.2 L29.4,1133.6 Q23.2,1127.5 29.3,1124.1" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><path d="M31.5,1128.1 L868.3,1125.0 Q874.2,1127.6 873.1,1128.0 L875.3,1184.5 Q877.1,1188.7 867.3,1189.7 L31.0,1190.2 Q25.9,1189.0 24.2,1184.4 L23.0,1133.3 Q24.3,1123.5 32.8,1127.1" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><text x="40.0" y="1147.1" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">⚠️</text><text x="66.0" y="1147.1" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">Agonisté-antagonisté (nalbufin, pentazocin) mají také strop a u pacienta na plném agonistovi mohou</text><text x="66.0" y="1166.4" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">vyvolat odvykací stav — stejně jako buprenorfin.</text></svg>

text-anchor="start">Rozcestník</text><text x="294.0" y="722.9" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Fosfolipáza A2 uvolní z membrány KYSELINU ARACHIDONOVOU; z ní</text><text x="294.0" y="743.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">vycházejí dvě větve.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="770.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Cesta COX</text><text x="294.0" y="775.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Cyklooxygenáza tvoří prostaglandiny (zánět, bolest, horečka,</text><text x="294.0" y="795.9" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">ochrana žaludeční sliznice, průtok ledvinami), prostacyklin PGI2</text><text x="294.0" y="816.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">(vazodilatace, brzdí agregaci) a tromboxan TXA2 (vazokonstrikce,</text><text x="294.0" y="836.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">podporuje agregaci).</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="863.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="869.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">3</text><text x="64.0" y="868.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">COX-1 versus COX-2</text><text x="294.0" y="868.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">COX-1 je konstitutivní (ochranná), COX-2 indukovaná zánětem.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="896.2" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="902.2" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">4</text><text x="64.0" y="901.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Cesta LOX</text><text x="294.0" y="901.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Lipoxygenáza tvoří LEUKOTRIENY — silná bronchokonstrikce, zvýšená</text><text x="294.0" y="921.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">propustnost cév a chemotaxe; odtud montelukast u astmatu.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="948.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="954.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">5</text><text x="64.0" y="953.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Kortikoid nahoře</text><text x="294.0" y="953.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Glukokortikoidy inhibují fosfolipázu A2 (přes lipokortin) a zavřou</text><text x="294.0" y="974.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">OBĚ větve — proto jsou protizánětlivě účinnější než NSA.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1001.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1007.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="64.0" y="1006.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Misoprostol</text><text x="294.0" y="1006.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Analog PGE1 chrání žaludek před NSA, ale je KONTRAINDIKOVÁN V</text><text x="294.0" y="1026.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">GRAVIDITĚ.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1054.1" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1060.1" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">7</text><text x="64.0" y="1059.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Latanoprost</text><text x="294.0" y="1059.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Léčebné využití eikosanoidů: latanoprost (glaukom), alprostadil,</text><text x="294.0" y="1079.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">dinoproston (indukce porodu), epoprostenol (plicní hypertenze).</text><rect x="27.0" y="743.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">(metoklopramid) proti zvracení a zpomalenému vyprazdňování žaludku.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="770.5" r="15" jsou agonisté 5-HT1B/1D —</text><text x="294.0" y="795.9" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">stahují rozšířené intrakraniální cévy a tlumí uvolňování</text><text text-anchor="start">Kontraindikace triptanů</text><text x="294.0" y="848.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Ischemická choroba srdeční, neléčená hypertenze, prodělaná cévní</text><text x="294.0" y="868.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">mozková příhoda, hemiplegická migréna. fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Profylaxe</text><text x="294.0" y="921.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Při častých nebo těžkých atakách: propranolol, metoprolol,</text><text x="294.0" y="941.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">topiramát, valproát (ne u žen ve fertilním věku), amitriptylin,</text><text x="294.0" y="962.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">kandesartan.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="989.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text text-anchor="start">Anti-CGRP</text><text x="294.0" y="994.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Monoklonální protilátky proti CGRP (erenumab) a gepanty.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1021.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1027.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="64.0" y="1026.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Bolest z nadužívání</text><text x="294.0" y="1026.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Vzniká při užívání analgetik více než ~10–15 dní v měsíci — léčí se</text><text x="294.0" y="1047.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">VYSAZENÍM, ne přidáním.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1074.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1080.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">7</text><text x="64.0" y="1079.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Ergotamin</text><text x="294.0" y="1079.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Dnes okrajově — silná a dlouhá vazokonstrikce, riziko ergotismu;</text><text x="294.0" y="1099.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">nikdy se nekombinuje s triptanem.</text><rect x="27.0" y="1126.1" width="846.0" height="62.5" rx="10" fill="#F7CFC4" opacity="0.42"/><path cy="717.9" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="723.9" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">1</text><text x="64.0" y="722.9" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Zaseknutá pumpa</text><text x="294.0" y="722.9" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Inhibice Na+/K+-ATPázy zvýší nitrobuněčný sodík, tím se zpomalí</text><text x="294.0" y="743.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">výměník Na+/Ca²+ a v buňce zůstane více VÁPNÍKU — odtud pozitivně</text><text x="294.0" y="763.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">inotropní účinek.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="790.9" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="796.9" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">2</text><text x="64.0" y="795.9" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Zpomalený převod</text><text x="294.0" y="795.9" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Zvyšuje tonus vagu — zpomaluje frekvenci a vedení AV uzlem; u</text><text x="294.0" y="816.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">fibrilace síní s rychlou odpovědí komor a u srdečního selhání se</text><text x="294.0" y="836.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">sníženou ejekční frakcí (mortalitu nesnižuje, jen příznaky).</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="863.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="869.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">3</text><text x="64.0" y="868.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Chybějící draslík</text><text x="294.0" y="868.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Digoxin soupeří s draslíkem o totéž vazebné místo — při HYPOKALEMII</text><text x="294.0" y="889.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">se váže víc a toxicita prudce roste. Pozor při kličkových a</text><text x="294.0" y="909.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">thiazidových diureticích, zvracení a průjmu.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="936.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="942.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">4</text><text x="64.0" y="941.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Žluté vidění</text><text x="294.0" y="941.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Intoxikace: nauzea, zvracení, průjem, poruchy barevného vidění</text><text x="294.0" y="962.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">(žlutozelené, halo), zmatenost a arytmie (bigeminie, AV blokáda).</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="989.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="995.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">5</text><text x="64.0" y="994.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Fab protilátky</text><text x="294.0" y="994.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Antidotem jsou protilátky (Fab fragmenty). Úzké terapeutické okno —</text><text x="294.0" y="1014.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">měří se hladiny.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1042.1" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1048.1" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="64.0" y="1047.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Ledvina</text><text x="294.0" y="1047.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Vylučuje se ledvinami — u renální insuficience a u seniorů se dávka</text><text x="294.0" y="1067.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">snižuje. Amiodaron, verapamil a chinidin hladinu zvyšují.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1094.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1100.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">7</text><text x="64.0" y="1099.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Ostatní inotropika</text><text x="294.0" y="1099.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Dobutamin (β1-agonista) a inhibitory fosfodiesterázy III (milrinon)</text><text x="294.0" y="1120.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">jen krátkodobě u akutního selhání; levosimendan zvyšuje citlivost</text><text x="294.0" y="1140.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">myofilament na vápník.</text><rect x="27.0" y="1166.8" width="846.0" height="62.5" rx="10" fill="#F7CFC4" opacity="0.42"/><path d="M31.4,1162.9 L864.7,1166.5 Q875.7,1167.8 873.3,1174.7 L873.4,1224.3 Q874.9,1228.4 866.6,1231.7 L31.0,1227.5 Q23.2,1232.9 28.0,1222.5 L27.2,1173.9 Q26.9,1166.9 34.6,1164.2" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><path d="M28.8,1164.3 L866.5,1162.9 Q872.3,1163.7 876.7,1169.7 L873.8,1225.3 Q872.7,1232.2 865.0,1232.5 L29.5,1233.4 Q22.7,1230.0 25.3,1223.8 L28.0,1172.4 Q27.0,1163.9 30.6,1163.9" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><text x="40.0" y="1187.8" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">⚠️</text><text x="66.0" y="1187.8" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">Hyperkalcemie a hypomagnezemie toxicitu digoxinu také zvyšují — proto se u pacienta na digoxinu</text><text x="66.0" y="1207.1" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">sledují ionty jako celek, ne jen draslík.</text></svg>
