text-anchor="start">Přepínač I — sodík</text><text x="294.0" y="722.9" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Ia (chinidin, prokainamid) prodlužují repolarizaci; Ib (lidokain,</text><text x="294.0" y="743.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">mexiletin) ji zkracují (komorové arytmie u ischemie); Ic</text><text x="294.0" y="763.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">(propafenon, flekainid) nejsilněji zpomalují vedení.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="790.9" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="796.9" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">2</text><text x="64.0" y="795.9" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Zákaz po infarktu</text><text x="294.0" y="795.9" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Třída Ic je kontraindikovaná po infarktu a při strukturálním</text><text x="294.0" y="816.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">postižení srdce — zvyšuje mortalitu.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="843.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="849.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">3</text><text x="64.0" y="848.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Přepínač II — beta</text><text x="294.0" y="848.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">β-blokátory zpomalují sinusový uzel a vedení AV uzlem; SNIŽUJÍ</text><text x="294.0" y="868.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">MORTALITU, což většina ostatních antiarytmik neumí.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="896.2" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="902.2" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">4</text><text x="64.0" y="901.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Přepínač III — draslík</text><text x="294.0" y="901.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Blokáda draslíkových kanálů prodlužuje repolarizaci a QT. AMIODARON</text><text x="294.0" y="921.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">je nejúčinnější, ale má rozsáhlou orgánovou toxicitu: plicní</text><text x="294.0" y="941.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">fibróza, hepatotoxicita, tyreopatie (obsahuje jod), depozita v</text><text x="294.0" y="962.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">rohovce, fotosenzitivita a šedomodré zbarvení kůže; poločas týdny</text><text x="294.0" y="982.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">až měsíce.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1009.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1015.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">5</text><text x="64.0" y="1014.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Přepínač IV — vápník</text><text x="294.0" y="1014.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Verapamil a diltiazem zpomalují AV uzel u supraventrikulárních</text><text x="294.0" y="1035.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">arytmií. NEKOMBINOVAT s β-blokátorem a nepodávat u srdečního</text><text x="294.0" y="1055.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">selhání se sníženou ejekční frakcí.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1082.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1088.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="64.0" y="1087.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Adenosin</text><text x="294.0" y="1087.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Mimo klasifikaci: adenosin (přechodná AV blokáda ukončí</text><text x="294.0" y="1108.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">supraventrikulární tachykardii), digoxin, magnezium u torsade de</text><text x="294.0" y="1128.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">pointes, ivabradin.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1155.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1161.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">7</text><text x="64.0" y="1160.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Torsade de pointes</text><text x="294.0" y="1160.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Léčiva prodlužující QT (III. třída, ale i makrolidy, chinolony,</text><text x="294.0" y="1181.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">antipsychotika, ondansetron) se v riziku SČÍTAJÍ.</text><rect x="27.0" y="1207.4" width="846.0" height="62.5" rx="10" fill="#F7CFC4" opacity="0.42"/><path d="M30.4,1206.1 draslíku.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="928.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="934.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Oboustranná stenóza renálních tepen je kontraindikací — filtrace</text><text x="294.0" y="953.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">závisí na angiotensinu II a její blokáda způsobí selhání ledvin.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="981.2" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" text-anchor="start">Gravidita</text><text x="294.0" y="986.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">ACE inhibitory i sartany jsou v graviditě ABSOLUTNĚ</text><text x="294.0" y="1006.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">kontraindikované — poškozují ledviny plodu, oligohydramnion,</text><text x="294.0" y="1026.8" x="294.0" y="1059.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Sakubitril/valsartan je u srdečního selhání účinnější než samotný</text><text x="294.0" y="1079.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">ACE inhibitor. frakcí snižují mortalitu: ACE</text><text x="294.0" y="743.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">inhibitor (nebo ARNI), β-blokátor, antagonista</text><text x="294.0" y="763.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">mineralokortikoidních receptorů a GLIFLOZINY.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="790.9" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Diuretikum</text><text x="294.0" y="795.9" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Kličková diuretika odstraní městnání a dušnost — zlepší PŘÍZNAKY,</text><text x="294.0" y="816.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">ale PROGNÓZU nezmění. Dávka se titruje podle hmotnosti a otoků.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="843.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="849.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">3</text><text x="64.0" y="848.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Pomalá titrace</text><text x="294.0" y="848.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">β-blokátor se zahajuje až u stabilizovaného pacienta a velmi nízkou</text><text x="294.0" y="868.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">dávkou — na začátku může selhání přechodně zhoršit, přestože</text><text x="294.0" y="889.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">dlouhodobě prodlužuje život.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="916.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="922.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">4</text><text x="64.0" y="921.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Zakázané léky</text><text x="294.0" y="921.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">NSA (retence sodíku a vody, zhoršení funkce ledvin), verapamil a</text><text x="294.0" y="941.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">diltiazem (negativně inotropní), glitazony, většina antiarytmik I.</text><text x="294.0" y="962.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">třídy.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="989.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="995.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">5</text><text x="64.0" y="994.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Digoxin</text><text x="294.0" y="994.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Zlepší příznaky a kontrolu frekvence u fibrilace síní; mortalitu</text><text x="294.0" y="1014.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">nesnižuje.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1042.1" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1048.1" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="64.0" y="1047.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Ivabradin</text><text x="294.0" y="1047.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Při vysoké frekvenci na sinusovém rytmu.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1074.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1080.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">7</text><text x="64.0" y="1079.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Zachovaná ejekční frakce</text><text x="294.0" y="1079.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Tam je průkaz účinku slabší — zůstávají glifloziny, léčba městnání</text><text x="294.0" y="1099.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">diuretikem a důsledná léčba přidružených chorob.</text><rect x="27.0" y="1126.1" V graviditě</text><text x="294.0" y="738.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">kontraindikovány.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="765.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="771.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">2</text><text x="64.0" y="770.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Dveře C</text><text x="294.0" y="770.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Blokátory kalciových kanálů (amlodipin) — vhodné u starších a u</text><text x="294.0" y="791.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">izolované systolické hypertenze; nežádoucí otoky kotníků.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="818.4" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="824.4" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">3</text><text x="64.0" y="823.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Dveře D</text><text x="294.0" y="823.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Thiazidy a indapamid — účinné a levné; pozor na hypokalemii,</text><text x="294.0" y="843.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">hyperurikemii a zhoršení glykemie.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="871.1" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="877.1" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">4</text><text x="64.0" y="876.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Dveře B</text><text x="294.0" y="876.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">β-blokátory dnes NEJSOU první volbou u nekomplikované hypertenze —</text><text x="294.0" y="896.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">nasazují se, existuje-li další důvod (ischemická choroba, srdeční</text><text x="294.0" y="916.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">selhání, arytmie, tyreotoxikóza).</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="944.1" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="950.1" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">5</text><text x="64.0" y="949.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Jedna tableta</text><text x="294.0" y="949.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Zahajuje se fixní dvojkombinací (A+C nebo A+D) — účinnější a lépe</text><text x="294.0" y="969.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">se dodržuje. ACE inhibitor a sartan se spolu nekombinují.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="996.7" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1002.7" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="64.0" y="1001.7" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Spironolakton</text><text x="294.0" y="1001.7" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">U rezistentní hypertenze se přidává spironolakton.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1029.1" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1035.1" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">7</text><text x="64.0" y="1034.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Gravidita</text><text x="294.0" y="1034.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Lékem volby jsou methyldopa, labetalol a nifedipin; ACE inhibitory,</text><text x="294.0" y="1054.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">sartany a atenolol jsou kontraindikované.</text><rect x="27.0" y="1080.7" width="846.0" height="62.5" rx="10" fill="#F7CFC4" opacity="0.42"/><path d="M28.8,1081.3 L868.8,1079.1 Q874.5,1081.7 873.6,1089.0 L874.5,1138.3 Q876.1,1142.1 868.7,1145.3 L33.2,1143.4 Q22.8,1146.1 27.5,1138.3 L25.2,1084.6 Q27.3,1079.1 31.6,1080.6" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><path d="M33.6,1078.1 L869.4,1079.9 Q874.7,1080.0 871.3,1085.9 L871.0,1136.0 Q873.5,1145.7 870.8,1144.0 L32.3,1143.0 Q23.5,1143.7 27.9,1135.4 L27.7,1088.6 Q25.1,1082.3 33.2,1080.7" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><text x="40.0" y="1101.7" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">⚠️</text><text x="66.0" y="1101.7" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">Cílem není samotné číslo na tonometru, ale snížení kardiovaskulárního rizika — proto se volí lék</text><text x="66.0" y="1121.0" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">podle přidružených chorob, ne jen podle síly účinku.</text></svg>

fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">RABDOMYOLÝZA s akutním selháním ledvin. Dále vzestup jaterních</text><text x="294.0" y="889.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">testů a mírně zvýšené riziko diabetu.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="916.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="922.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">4</text><text x="64.0" y="921.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Grapefruit a makrolid</text><text x="294.0" y="921.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Riziko myopatie prudce stoupá s inhibitory CYP3A4 (klarithromycin,</text><text x="294.0" y="941.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">itrakonazol, verapamil, grapefruit) a s fibráty (zvlášť</text><text x="294.0" y="962.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">gemfibrozilem). Rosuvastatin a pravastatin jsou přes CYP3A4</text><text x="294.0" y="982.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">metabolizovány méně.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1009.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1015.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">5</text><text x="64.0" y="1014.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Gravidita</text><text x="294.0" y="1014.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Statiny jsou v graviditě a při kojení kontraindikované —</text><text x="294.0" y="1035.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">cholesterol je nezbytný pro vývoj plodu.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1062.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1068.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="64.0" y="1067.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Ezetimib</text><text x="294.0" y="1067.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Blokuje vstřebávání cholesterolu ve střevě; inhibitory PCSK9</text><text x="294.0" y="1087.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">(evolokumab, alirokumab) injekčně a velmi účinně.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1115.1" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1121.1" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">7</text><text x="64.0" y="1120.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Fibráty a pryskyřice</text><text x="294.0" y="1120.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Fibráty hlavně na triglyceridy; kolestyramin váže žlučové kyseliny</text><text x="294.0" y="1140.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">a zhoršuje vstřebávání jiných léčiv a vitaminů rozpustných v</text><text x="294.0" y="1160.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">tucích.</text><rect x="27.0" y="1187.1" width="846.0" height="62.5" rx="10" fill="#F7CFC4" opacity="0.42"/><path d="M34.5,1183.5 L871.0,1186.5 Q876.9,1183.9 873.6,1194.3 L874.6,1246.6 Q874.6,1250.2 866.5,1250.2 L29.1,1252.8 Q29.2,1251.6 28.8,1244.2 L25.4,1188.8 Q24.8,1187.5 30.5,1185.4" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><path d="M32.9,1186.1 L867.7,1188.2 Q870.7,1189.3 874.9,1191.2 L872.4,1242.3 Q874.1,1250.7 866.2,1248.9 L34.1,1253.9 Q24.7,1251.0 23.2,1246.9 L25.7,1192.5 Q22.9,1187.7 30.5,1188.1" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><text x="40.0" y="1208.1" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">⚠️</text><text x="66.0" y="1208.1" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">Bolest svalů při statinu bývá i nocebo — proto se ověří kreatinkináza a zkusí jiný statin nebo nižší</text><text x="66.0" y="1227.4" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">dávka, než se skupina opustí úplně.</text></svg>

x="294.0" y="697.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Heparin sám nesráží — mnohonásobně zesiluje účinek antitrombinu</text><text x="294.0" y="718.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">III, který inaktivuje trombin (IIa) a faktor Xa.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="745.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="751.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">2</text><text x="64.0" y="750.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">aPTT</text><text x="294.0" y="750.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">NEFRAKCIONOVANÝ heparin: nitrožilně, krátký poločas, sleduje se</text><text x="294.0" y="770.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">aPTT. Výhodou je rychlá ovladatelnost a použitelnost při renálním</text><text x="294.0" y="791.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">selhání.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="818.4" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="824.4" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">3</text><text x="64.0" y="823.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Protamin</text><text x="294.0" y="823.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">ANTIDOTEM nefrakcionovaného heparinu je PROTAMIN-SULFÁT; u</text><text x="294.0" y="843.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">nízkomolekulárního zvrátí účinek jen částečně.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="871.1" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="877.1" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">4</text><text x="64.0" y="876.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Podkožní injekce</text><text x="294.0" y="876.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">LMWH (enoxaparin, nadroparin, dalteparin) působí hlavně na faktor</text><text x="294.0" y="896.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Xa; subkutánně, předvídatelný účinek, bez rutinní monitorace (jen</text><text x="294.0" y="916.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">anti-Xa u gravidity, obezity a renální insuficience).</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="944.1" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="950.1" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">5</text><text x="64.0" y="949.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Ledvina</text><text x="294.0" y="949.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">LMWH se vylučují ledvinami — u renální insuficience se dávka</text><text x="294.0" y="969.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">snižuje.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="996.7" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1002.7" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="64.0" y="1001.7" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">HIT</text><text x="294.0" y="1001.7" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Heparinem indukovaná TROMBOCYTOPENIE (typ II, 5.–10. den) vede</text><text x="294.0" y="1022.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">paradoxně k TROMBÓZE, nikoli ke krvácení. Heparin se okamžitě</text><text x="294.0" y="1042.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">vysadí a nahradí argatrobanem nebo fondaparinuxem.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1069.7" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1075.7" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">7</text><text x="64.0" y="1074.7" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Gravidita</text><text x="294.0" y="1074.7" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Hepariny neprocházejí placentou — proto jsou antikoagulanciem volby</text><text x="294.0" y="1095.0" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">v graviditě.</text><rect x="27.0" y="1121.4" width="846.0" height="62.5" rx="10" fill="#F7CFC4" opacity="0.42"/><path d="M31.6,1118.0 L866.4,1122.8 Q870.7,1122.4 873.6,1126.4 L871.4,1177.3 Q874.7,1187.8 871.0,1185.9 L33.7,1187.9 Q27.8,1188.2 27.4,1177.7 L24.7,1126.2 Q27.5,1117.6 34.2,1121.9" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><path d="M33.1,1118.7 L865.1,1121.3 Q877.0,1117.8 871.6,1127.2 L875.5,1181.0 Q873.7,1187.9 867.1,1184.1 L33.0,1187.7 Q23.7,1182.6 28.5,1178.9 L27.7,1126.4 Q24.6,1118.9 32.1,1122.1" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><text x="40.0" y="1142.4" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">⚠️</text><text x="66.0" y="1142.4" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">Dlouhodobé podávání heparinu způsobuje osteoporózu a vzestup jaterních testů; u nízkomolekulárního je</text><text x="66.0" y="1161.6" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">toto riziko nižší než u nefrakcionovaného.</text></svg>

antagonista vitaminu K — listová zelenina a brokolice</text><text x="294.0" y="743.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">jeho účinek SNIŽUJÍ. Účinek se sleduje pomocí INR (u fibrilace síní</text><text x="294.0" y="763.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">cíl 2–3).</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="790.9" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="796.9" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">2</text><text x="64.0" y="795.9" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Pavučina</text><text x="294.0" y="795.9" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Blokuje vitamin K-epoxidreduktázu, a tím γ-karboxylaci faktorů II,</text><text x="294.0" y="816.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">VII, IX a X.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="843.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="849.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">3</text><text x="64.0" y="848.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Přesýpací hodiny</text><text x="294.0" y="848.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Nástup 3–5 dní. Nejkratší poločas mají PROTEINY C a S — proto na</text><text x="294.0" y="868.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">začátku převáží prokoagulační stav (kožní nekróza) a překrývá se</text><text x="294.0" y="889.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">heparinem.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="916.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="922.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">4</text><text x="64.0" y="921.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Antibiotika</text><text x="294.0" y="921.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Likvidují střevní bakterie tvořící vitamin K → INR stoupá. Totéž</text><text x="294.0" y="941.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">amiodaron, metronidazol, azoly, NSA a alkohol.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="969.2" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="975.2" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">5</text><text x="64.0" y="974.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Těhotná</text><text x="294.0" y="974.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Warfarin je v graviditě teratogenní — tam patří nízkomolekulární</text><text x="294.0" y="994.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">heparin.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1021.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1027.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="64.0" y="1026.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Vitamin K</text><text x="294.0" y="1026.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Antidotum warfarinu: vitamin K, při závažném krvácení koncentrát</text><text x="294.0" y="1047.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">protrombinového komplexu.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1074.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1080.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">7</text><text x="64.0" y="1079.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">DOAC</text><text x="294.0" y="1079.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Dabigatran (přímý inhibitor trombinu, antidotum idarucizumab) a</text><text x="294.0" y="1099.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">xabany — rivaroxaban, apixaban, edoxaban (inhibitory Xa, antidotum</text><text x="294.0" y="1120.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">andexanet alfa). font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Destička nemá jádro a nový enzym nevytvoří — účinek trvá po celou</text><text x="294.0" y="770.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="64.0" y="981.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Ibuprofen před aspirinem</text><text x="294.0" y="981.4" font-size="15.4" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1014.7" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">7</text><text x="64.0" y="1013.7" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Duální antiagregace</text><text x="294.0" y="1013.7" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">ASA + inhibitor P2Y12 po akutním koronárním syndromu a po</text><text x="294.0" y="1034.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">implantaci stentu po stanovenou dobu; inhibitory glykoproteinu</text><text x="294.0" y="743.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">a podávají se těsně před jídlem; krátký humánní inzulin 30 minut</text><text x="294.0" y="763.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">předem.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="790.9" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="796.9" font-size="17" y="795.9" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Dlouhodobě působící analoga (glargin, detemir, degludek) mají</text><text x="294.0" y="816.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">plochý profil bez vrcholu — nižší riziko noční hypoglykemie než NPH</text><text x="294.0" y="836.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">inzulin.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="863.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="869.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">3</text><text x="64.0" y="868.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Hypoglykemie</text><text x="294.0" y="868.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Nejnebezpečnější komplikace: pocení, třes, palpitace, hlad</text><text x="294.0" y="889.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">(adrenergní) a poté zmatenost, porucha chování, křeče, kóma</text><text x="294.0" y="909.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">(neuroglykopenické).</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="936.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="942.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">4</text><text x="64.0" y="941.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">β-blokátor</text><text x="294.0" y="941.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Maskuje adrenergní varovné příznaky — kromě pocení.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="969.2" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="975.2" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">5</text><text x="64.0" y="974.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Cukr ústy</text><text x="294.0" y="974.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Při vědomí cukr ústy; při bezvědomí glukóza nitrožilně.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1001.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1007.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="64.0" y="1006.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Glukagon</text><text x="294.0" y="1006.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">I.m. nebo intranazálně; NEPŮSOBÍ při vyčerpaných jaterních zásobách</text><text x="294.0" y="1026.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">glykogenu (například u alkoholika). Používá se i jako antidotum při</text><text x="294.0" y="1047.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">předávkování β-blokátory.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1074.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1080.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">7</text><text x="64.0" y="1079.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Přírůstek hmotnosti</text><text x="294.0" y="1079.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Inzulin vede k přírůstku hmotnosti, lipodystrofii v místě vpichu</text><text x="294.0" y="1099.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">(střídat místa) a hypokalemii — toho se využívá v léčbě</text><text x="294.0" y="1120.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">hyperkalemie.</text><rect x="27.0" y="1146.5" width="846.0" height="62.5" rx="10" text-anchor="start">Režim bazál-bolus napodobuje fyziologickou sekreci — proto se dávka bazálu upravuje podle glykemie</text><text x="66.0" y="1186.7" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Metformin v čele</text><text x="294.0" y="722.9" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">PRVNÍ VOLBA u diabetu 2. typu — snižuje jaterní glukoneogenezi a</text><text x="294.0" y="743.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">zvyšuje citlivost k inzulinu. Nezpůsobuje hypoglykemii ani</text><text x="294.0" y="763.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">přírůstek hmotnosti.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="790.9" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="796.9" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">2</text><text x="64.0" y="795.9" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Laktátová acidóza</text><text x="294.0" y="795.9" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Metformin je kontraindikován při renální insuficienci, hypoxii,</text><text x="294.0" y="816.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">těžkém jaterním onemocnění a alkoholismu; před jodovou kontrastní</text><text x="294.0" y="836.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">látkou a před operací se VYSAZUJE. Dále průjem, nauzea a deficit</text><text x="294.0" y="856.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">vitaminu B12.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="884.2" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="890.2" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">3</text><text x="64.0" y="889.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Cukr v moči</text><text x="294.0" y="889.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">GLIFLOZINY (dapagliflozin, empagliflozin) blokují SGLT2 — cukr</text><text x="294.0" y="909.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">odchází močí. Snižují hmotnost, tlak a mortalitu u srdečního</text><text x="294.0" y="929.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">selhání, chrání ledviny.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="957.2" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="963.2" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">4</text><text x="64.0" y="962.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Genitální mykóza</text><text x="294.0" y="962.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Typický nežádoucí účinek gliflozinů; vzácně euglykemická</text><text x="294.0" y="982.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">ketoacidóza.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1009.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1015.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">5</text><text x="64.0" y="1014.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">GLP-1 agonisté</text><text x="294.0" y="1014.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Liraglutid, semaglutid, dulaglutid — zpomalují vyprazdňování</text><text x="294.0" y="1035.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">žaludku, zvyšují sytost, snižují hmotnost a kardiovaskulární</text><text x="294.0" y="1055.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">riziko; nauzea, riziko pankreatitidy. Gliptiny (sitagliptin) jsou</text><text x="294.0" y="1075.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">hmotnostně neutrální.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1103.1" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1109.1" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="64.0" y="1108.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Sulfonylurea</text><text x="294.0" y="1108.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Gliklazid a glimepirid zavírají draslíkový kanál β-buňky a</text><text x="294.0" y="1128.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">vyplavují inzulin — způsobují HYPOGLYKEMII a přírůstek hmotnosti.</text><text x="294.0" y="1148.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Totéž glinidy.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1176.1" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1182.1" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">7</text><text x="64.0" y="1181.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Pioglitazon</text><text x="294.0" y="1181.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Zvyšuje citlivost, ale působí retenci tekutin a je kontraindikován</text><text x="294.0" y="1201.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">u srdečního selhání.</text><rect x="27.0" y="1227.8" width="846.0" height="62.5" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Meč — baktericidní</text><text x="294.0" y="722.9" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Betalaktamy, glykopeptidy, aminoglykosidy, chinolony, metronidazol.</text><text x="294.0" y="743.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">U imunokompromitovaného, u ENDOKARDITIDY a MENINGITIDY je</text><text x="294.0" y="763.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">baktericidní léčba nutná.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="790.9" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="796.9" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">2</text><text x="64.0" y="795.9" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Štít — bakteriostatické</text><text x="294.0" y="795.9" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Makrolidy, tetracykliny, linkosamidy, sulfonamidy, chloramfenikol —</text><text x="294.0" y="816.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">brzdí množení, zbytek musí dodělat imunita.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="843.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="849.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">3</text><text x="64.0" y="848.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Odběr před léčbou</text><text x="294.0" y="848.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Empirická léčba se zahajuje podle nejpravděpodobnějšího původce a</text><text x="294.0" y="868.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">lokální epidemiologie, ale ODBĚR NA KULTIVACI se dělá PŘED prvním</text><text x="294.0" y="889.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">podáním. Po výsledku se deeskaluje na co nejužší spektrum.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="916.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="922.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">4</text><text x="64.0" y="921.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Časově závislé</text><text x="294.0" y="921.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Betalaktamy zabíjejí časově závisle — rozhoduje doba nad minimální</text><text x="294.0" y="941.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">inhibiční koncentrací; podávají se častěji nebo v prodloužené</text><text x="294.0" y="962.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">infuzi.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="989.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="995.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">5</text><text x="64.0" y="994.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Koncentračně závislé</text><text x="294.0" y="994.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Aminoglykosidy a chinolony — podávají se jednou denně ve vysoké</text><text x="294.0" y="1014.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">dávce.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1042.1" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1048.1" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="64.0" y="1047.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Rezistence</text><text x="294.0" y="1047.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Vzniká mutací nebo přenosem plazmidu. Zásady: nepodávat na virózu,</text><text x="294.0" y="1067.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">dodržet dávku a délku, nezaměňovat kolonizaci za infekci, používat</text><text x="294.0" y="1087.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">co nejužší spektrum.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1115.1" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1121.1" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">7</text><text x="64.0" y="1120.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Nevhodná kombinace</text><text x="294.0" y="1120.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Baktericidní se zpravidla nekombinuje s bakteriostatickým — to by</text><text x="294.0" y="1140.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">účinek oslabilo.</text><rect x="27.0" y="1166.8" width="846.0" height="62.5" rx="10" fill="#F7CFC4" opacity="0.42"/><path d="M33.0,1167.7 L865.2,1168.2 Q875.8,1163.4 877.3,1168.4 L873.6,1222.6 Q871.6,1233.5 871.2,1232.9 L30.6,1232.8 Q27.1,1231.7 26.4,1225.3 L27.8,1169.2 Q29.1,1167.0 30.2,1165.0" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><path d="M29.6,1167.4 L869.4,1164.2 Q871.1,1165.9 871.0,1168.9 L870.9,1223.1 Q871.6,1230.2 866.6,1233.3 L30.0,1233.1 Q25.8,1229.1 24.4,1226.0 L29.0,1170.1 Q23.5,1166.3 32.1,1165.0" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><text x="40.0" y="1187.8" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">⚠️</text><text x="66.0" y="1187.8" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">Profylaxe má být krátká a cílená: chirurgická jedna dávka před výkonem. Delší podávání nechrání víc,</text><text x="66.0" y="1207.1" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">jen selektuje rezistentní kmeny.</text></svg>

font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">účinek prakticky nemají — obětují se enzymu a chrání antibiotikum</text><text x="294.0" y="868.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">(amoxicilin/klavulanát, piperacilin/tazobaktam).</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="896.2" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="902.2" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">4</text><text x="64.0" y="901.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Penicilin G a V</text><text x="294.0" y="901.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Přirozené — streptokoky, spirochéty (lék volby u syfilis), anaeroby</text><text x="294.0" y="921.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">dutiny ústní.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="948.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="954.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">5</text><text x="64.0" y="953.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Oxacilin</text><text x="294.0" y="953.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Protistafylokokové, odolné penicilináze. Aminopeniciliny</text><text x="294.0" y="974.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">(amoxicilin, ampicilin) mají širší spektrum; piperacilin pokrývá</text><text x="294.0" y="994.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Pseudomonas.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1021.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1027.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="64.0" y="1026.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Alergie</text><text x="294.0" y="1026.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Peniciliny jsou nejčastějším lékovým alergenem; anafylaxe v</text><text x="294.0" y="1047.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">anamnéze je kontraindikací celé skupiny. Zkřížená alergie s</text><text x="294.0" y="1067.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">cefalosporiny existuje, ale je nižší, než se dřív uvádělo.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1094.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1100.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">7</text><text x="64.0" y="1099.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Exantém u mononukleózy</text><text x="294.0" y="1099.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Ampicilin u infekční mononukleózy vyvolá exantém, který NENÍ</text><text x="294.0" y="1120.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">alergií.</text><rect x="27.0" y="1146.5" width="846.0" height="62.5" rx="10" fill="#F7CFC4" opacity="0.42"/><path d="M34.3,1146.8 L865.5,1145.7 Q873.3,1145.1 876.3,1153.2 L872.9,1203.9 Q876.6,1208.3 867.2,1208.7 L34.2,1211.4 Q28.5,1211.3 27.0,1203.6 L23.2,1154.1 Q24.1,1144.4 31.5,1145.6" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><path d="M31.7,1145.4 L867.4,1148.1 Q875.8,1144.7 875.2,1149.5 L873.4,1205.7 Q874.8,1209.8 870.6,1209.4 L28.8,1208.3 Q25.3,1210.1 25.1,1204.8 L28.5,1151.7 Q27.5,1148.5 33.0,1143.9" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><text x="40.0" y="1167.5" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">⚠️</text><text x="66.0" y="1167.5" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">Peniciliny mají velmi široké terapeutické okno a jsou bezpečné i v graviditě — hlavním nežádoucím</text><text x="66.0" y="1186.7" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">účinkem je průjem a alergie, nikoli orgánová toxicita.</text></svg>

REZERVNÍ antibiotika pro těžké a rezistentní</text><text x="294.0" y="921.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">infekce.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="948.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="954.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">5</text><text x="64.0" y="953.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Imipenem a křeče</text><text x="294.0" y="953.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Imipenem snižuje práh křečí; ertapenem nepokrývá Pseudomonas.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="981.2" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="987.2" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="64.0" y="986.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Mezera ve spektru</text><text x="294.0" y="986.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Běžné cefalosporiny NEPŮSOBÍ na enterokoky, MRSA, listerie a</text><text x="294.0" y="1006.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">atypické patogeny — klasická zkušební otázka.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1033.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1039.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">7</text><text x="64.0" y="1038.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Aztreonam</text><text x="294.0" y="1038.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Monobaktam působí pouze na gram-negativní aeroby; nemá zkříženou</text><text x="294.0" y="1059.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">alergii s peniciliny, proto je volbou u těžké alergie na</text><text x="294.0" y="1079.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">betalaktamy.</text><rect x="27.0" y="1105.8" width="846.0" height="62.5" rx="10" fill="#F7CFC4" opacity="0.42"/><path d="M32.9,1105.5 L864.8,1108.1 Q875.9,1107.0 873.2,1108.0 L873.1,1161.6 Q874.0,1166.4 866.7,1169.1 L31.0,1172.4 Q24.7,1168.3 26.6,1165.9 L24.1,1107.6 Q23.0,1103.3 30.4,1102.3" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><path d="M30.3,1102.4 L869.4,1107.1 Q870.7,1107.7 876.8,1108.7 L873.2,1166.5 Q875.1,1166.8 870.6,1172.3 L32.3,1171.3 Q23.3,1168.2 23.9,1162.6 L28.9,1110.2 Q25.0,1103.3 30.8,1104.9" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><text x="40.0" y="1126.8" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">⚠️</text><text x="66.0" y="1126.8" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">Cefalosporiny širokého spektra silně narušují střevní mikroflóru — patří k nejrizikovějším</text><text x="66.0" y="1146.1" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">antibiotikům z hlediska klostridiové kolitidy.</text></svg>

font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Chinolony inhibují bakteriální TOPOIZOMERÁZU II (DNA-gyrázu) a IV —</text><text x="294.0" y="989.7" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" x="294.0" y="697.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">KLINDAMYCIN (linkosamid, blokuje 50S) proniká dobře do kostí a</text><text x="294.0" y="718.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">působí na anaeroby a stafylokoky, ale z antibiotik NEJČASTĚJI</text><text x="294.0" y="738.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">vyvolává pseudomembranózní kolitidu (Clostridioides difficile).</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="765.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="771.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">2</text><text x="64.0" y="770.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Rudý muž</text><text x="294.0" y="770.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">VANKOMYCIN podaný rychlou infuzí uvolní histamin — zarudnutí</text><text x="294.0" y="791.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">obličeje a trupu, svědění, hypotenze. NENÍ to alergie; řeší se</text><text x="294.0" y="811.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">zpomalením infuze a antihistaminikem.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="838.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Jen gram-pozitivní</text><text x="294.0" y="843.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Glykopeptidy (vankomycin, teikoplanin) blokují stavbu stěny (vazba</text><text x="294.0" y="864.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">na D-alanyl-D-alanin) a působí POUZE na gram-pozitivní bakterie.</text><text x="294.0" y="884.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Rezerva na MRSA.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="911.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="917.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">4</text><text x="64.0" y="916.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Nefrotoxicita</text><text x="294.0" y="916.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Vankomycin je nefrotoxický a ototoxický — nutná monitorace hladin.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="944.1" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="950.1" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">5</text><text x="64.0" y="949.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Perorální vankomycin</text><text x="294.0" y="949.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Nevstřebává se a používá se právě na klostridiovou kolitidu —</text><text x="294.0" y="969.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">nitrožilně se do střevního lumen nedostane.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="996.7" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1002.7" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="64.0" y="1001.7" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Kolistin</text><text x="294.0" y="1001.7" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Polymyxin E narušuje membránu gram-negativních bakterií jako</text><text x="294.0" y="1022.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">detergent; výrazně nefrotoxický a neurotoxický — poslední možnost u</text><text x="294.0" y="1042.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">multirezistentních kmenů.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1069.7" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1075.7" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">7</text><text x="64.0" y="1074.7" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Fidaxomicin</text><text x="294.0" y="1074.7" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Klostridiová kolitida se léčí perorálním vankomycinem nebo</text><text x="294.0" y="1095.0" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">fidaxomicinem, případně metronidazolem; při recidivách</text><text x="294.0" y="1115.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">transplantací fekální mikroflóry.</text><rect x="27.0" y="1141.7" width="846.0" height="62.5" rx="10" fill="#F7CFC4" text-anchor="start">Antibiotikum, které nejčastěji způsobí klostridiovou kolitidu, není totéž jako to, kterým se léčí —</text><text x="66.0" y="1182.0" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" x="294.0" y="697.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Chelatace s Ca²⁺, Mg²⁺, Al³⁺ a Fe — nezapíjet mlékem, neužívat s</text><text x="294.0" y="718.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">antacidy, železem a vápníkem.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="745.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="751.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">2</text><text x="64.0" y="750.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Obarvený zub</text><text x="294.0" y="750.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Ukládá se do mineralizující tkáně; šedohnědé zbarvení je UVNITŘ</text><text x="294.0" y="770.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">skloviny a dentinu — bělením ani leštěním se neodstraní.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="798.1" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="804.1" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">3</text><text x="64.0" y="803.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Dítě u plotu</text><text x="294.0" y="803.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Kontraindikace do 8 let věku, v graviditě a při kojení — hypoplazie</text><text x="294.0" y="823.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">skloviny a zbarvení zubů.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="850.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="856.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">4</text><text x="64.0" y="855.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Pálící slunce</text><text x="294.0" y="855.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Fotosenzitivita — pacienta je nutné varovat před sluněním. Dále</text><text x="294.0" y="876.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">ezofagitida (zapíjet velkým množstvím vody a nelehat si).</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="903.4" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="909.4" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">5</text><text x="64.0" y="908.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Terč s číslem 30</text><text x="294.0" y="908.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Blokáda 30S podjednotky ribozomu = PROTEOSYNTÉZA, nikoli buněčná</text><text x="294.0" y="928.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">stěna. Bakteriostatické.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="956.1" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="962.1" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="64.0" y="961.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Klíště a pavouk</text><text x="294.0" y="961.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Široké spektrum včetně atypických: chlamydie, mykoplazmata,</text><text x="294.0" y="981.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">borrelie, rickettsie. Doxycyklin je dnes hlavní zástupce.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1008.7" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1014.7" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">7</text><text x="64.0" y="1013.7" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Šedé miminko</text><text x="294.0" y="1013.7" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Amfenikoly — chloramfenikol blokuje 50S. Aplastická anemie (typ B,</text><text x="294.0" y="1034.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">nezávislá na dávce) a gray baby syndrom u novorozence s nezralou</text><text x="294.0" y="1054.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">glukuronidací; zůstal v očních kapkách.</text><rect x="27.0" y="1080.7" width="846.0" height="62.5" rx="10" fill="#F7CFC4" opacity="0.42"/><path d="M34.0,1078.6 L871.3,1081.7 Q873.5,1081.9 874.8,1088.7 L871.9,1138.1 Q874.6,1144.1 865.0,1144.1 L34.9,1146.8 Q23.7,1147.4 27.4,1141.1 L22.7,1087.2 Q25.5,1079.9 31.9,1076.4" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><path d="M33.0,1078.5 L867.3,1076.8 Q874.8,1077.7 873.1,1085.3 L871.2,1135.2 Q875.0,1146.0 865.0,1143.5 L33.4,1141.0 Q27.0,1144.5 24.0,1140.9 L28.3,1088.0 Q23.7,1078.6 30.5,1080.0" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><text x="40.0" y="1101.7" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">⚠️</text><text x="66.0" y="1101.7" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">Ve zdroji katedry je u tetracyklinů uvedena inhibice buněčné stěny — to je chyba. Stěnu blokují</text><text x="66.0" y="1121.0" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">betalaktamy a glykopeptidy.</text></svg>

text-anchor="start">Patogen bez stěny</text><text x="294.0" y="722.9" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Blokují 50S podjednotku ribozomu, bakteriostaticky. Pokrývají</text><text x="294.0" y="743.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">mykoplazmata, chlamydie, legionelu a původce černého kašle — na ty</text><text x="294.0" y="763.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">betalaktamy nefungují.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="790.9" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="796.9" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">2</text><text x="64.0" y="795.9" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Náhrada penicilinu</text><text x="294.0" y="795.9" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Jsou alternativou u pacientů s alergií na penicilin, bez zkřížené</text><text x="294.0" y="816.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">reakce.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="843.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="849.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">3</text><text x="64.0" y="848.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Klarithromycin</text><text x="294.0" y="848.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Erythromycin a klarithromycin jsou SILNÉ INHIBITORY CYP3A4 —</text><text x="294.0" y="868.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">zvyšují hladiny statinů (rabdomyolýza), warfarinu (krvácení),</text><text x="294.0" y="889.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">cyklosporinu, karbamazepinu a blokátorů kalciových kanálů.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="916.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="922.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">4</text><text x="64.0" y="921.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Azithromycin</text><text x="294.0" y="921.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">CYP3A4 prakticky neinhibuje — volba u polymorbidního pacienta. Má</text><text x="294.0" y="941.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">velmi dlouhý tkáňový poločas, třídenní kúra působí ještě řadu dní.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="969.2" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="975.2" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">5</text><text x="64.0" y="974.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Prodloužené QT</text><text x="294.0" y="974.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Sčítá se s chinolony, antipsychotiky a ondansetronem.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1001.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1007.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="64.0" y="1006.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Žaludek</text><text x="294.0" y="1006.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Gastrointestinální nesnášenlivost — erythromycin dráždí žaludek</text><text x="294.0" y="1026.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">přes MOTILINOVÝ receptor.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1054.1" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1060.1" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">7</text><text x="64.0" y="1059.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Prokinetikum</text><text x="294.0" y="1059.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Této vlastnosti se využívá, když se erythromycin podává jako</text><text x="294.0" y="1079.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">prokinetikum u gastroparézy.</text><rect x="27.0" y="1105.8" width="846.0" height="62.5" rx="10" fill="#F7CFC4" opacity="0.42"/><path d="M32.7,1103.0 L870.6,1103.1 fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="796.9" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">2</text><text x="64.0" y="795.9" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Zákaz u pyelonefritidy</text><text x="294.0" y="795.9" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Netvoří tkáňové hladiny; kontraindikován při renální insuficienci</text><text x="294.0" y="816.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">(nedostane se do moči) a v posledním trimestru font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Dlouhodobě hrozí plicní fibróza a polyneuropatie.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="875.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" jednorázová</text><text x="294.0" y="901.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">dávka 3 g u nekomplikované cystitidy. Dále kotrimoxazol a u</text><text x="294.0" y="921.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">komplikovaných infekcí chinolony.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="948.8" r="15" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Rifaximin</text><text x="294.0" y="953.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Nevstřebatelný derivát rifamycinu — cestovatelský průjem a prevence</text><text x="294.0" y="974.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">JATERNÍ ENCEFALOPATIE (snižuje střevní produkci amoniaku).</text><text x="294.0" y="994.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Nifuroxazid je střevní nitrofuran.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1021.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1027.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="64.0" y="1026.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Perorální vankomycin</text><text x="294.0" y="1026.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Nevstřebává se a je léčbou klostridiové kolitidy, stejně jako</text><text x="294.0" y="1047.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">fidaxomicin.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1074.5" r="15" —</text><text x="294.0" y="889.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">hemolýza.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="916.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="922.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">4</text><text x="64.0" y="921.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Červ</text><text x="294.0" y="921.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">ALBENDAZOL a mebendazol vážou β-tubulin červa a blokují příjem</text><text x="294.0" y="941.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">glukózy — široké spektrum hlístic.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="969.2" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="975.2" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">5</text><text x="64.0" y="974.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Motolice</text><text x="294.0" y="974.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">PRAZIQUANTEL zvyšuje propustnost membrány parazita pro vápník —</text><text x="294.0" y="994.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">motolice a tasemnice.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1021.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Ivermektin</text><text x="294.0" y="1026.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Otevírá glutamátem řízené chloridové kanály; užívá se i u svrabu.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1054.1" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1060.1" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">7</text><text x="64.0" y="1059.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Toxoplazmóza</text><text x="294.0" y="1059.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Pyrimethamin se sulfadiazinem a kyselinou listovou. Ektoparazitika:</text><text x="294.0" y="1079.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">permethrin a ivermektin na svrab a veš.</text><rect x="27.0" y="1105.8" width="846.0" height="62.5" rx="10" fill="#F7CFC4" opacity="0.42"/><path d="M32.5,1101.8 L870.1,1104.0 Q876.3,1107.4 874.3,1109.9 L871.6,1161.6 Q874.5,1168.7 866.9,1167.4 L32.0,1167.4 Q24.4,1167.6 27.2,1163.9 L26.8,1112.6 Q25.1,1101.7 31.0,1103.9" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><path d="M32.2,1104.0 L869.1,1105.5 Q876.0,1102.5 873.6,1110.8 L873.3,1166.1 Q872.0,1166.4 869.0,1172.1 L32.3,1168.8 Q29.3,1168.4 29.1,1162.0 L28.6,1113.3 Q22.8,1103.9 34.0,1107.6" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><text x="40.0" y="1126.8" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">⚠️</text><text x="66.0" y="1126.8" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">Selektivní toxicita je tu klíčová: co poškodí parazita, nesmí poškodit hostitele — proto se cílí na</text><text x="66.0" y="1146.1" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">struktury, které se od savčích liší.</text></svg>

lokálně</text><text x="294.0" y="743.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">klotrimazol) inhibují 14-α-demetylázu, tedy syntézu ergosterolu.</text><text x="294.0" y="763.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Fungistatické.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="790.9" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="796.9" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">2</text><text x="64.0" y="795.9" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Interakce</text><text x="294.0" y="795.9" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Azoly inhibují CYP3A4 — zvyšují hladiny statinů, warfarinu,</text><text x="294.0" y="816.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">cyklosporinu a takrolimu.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="843.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="849.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">3</text><text x="64.0" y="848.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" a děruje membránu;</text><text x="294.0" y="868.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">fungicidní, pro těžké systémové mykózy. Silně NEFROTOXICKÝ, horečka</text><text x="294.0" y="889.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">a třesavka při infuzi; lipozomální forma je snášena lépe.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="916.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="922.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">4</text><text x="64.0" y="921.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Nystatin</text><text x="294.0" y="921.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Polyen jen k lokálnímu a perorálnímu (nevstřebatelnému) použití —</text><text x="294.0" y="941.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">kandidóza dutiny ústní a střeva.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="969.2" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="975.2" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">5</text><text x="64.0" y="974.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Glukanová stěna</text><text x="294.0" y="974.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">ECHINOKANDINY (kaspofungin, anidulafungin, mikafungin) blokují</text><text x="294.0" y="994.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">syntézu β-glukanu — lidská buňka stěnu nemá, proto jsou velmi dobře</text><text x="294.0" y="1014.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">snášené; lék volby u invazivní kandidózy.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1042.1" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1048.1" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="64.0" y="1047.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Terbinafin</text><text x="294.0" y="1047.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Inhibuje skvalenepoxidázu — onychomykózy a dermatofytózy.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1074.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1080.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">7</text><text x="64.0" y="1079.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Flucytosin</text><text x="294.0" y="1079.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Vestavuje se do RNA, kombinuje se s amfotericinem u kryptokokové</text><text x="294.0" y="1099.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">meningitidy.</text><rect x="27.0" y="1126.1" width="846.0"
