y="743.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">aktivuje se pouze v infikované buňce, což vysvětluje jeho vysokou</text><text x="294.0" y="763.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">bezpečnost. Valaciklovir má lepší dostupnost.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="790.9" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="796.9" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">2</text><text x="64.0" y="795.9" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Terminátor řetězce</text><text x="294.0" y="795.9" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Aktivní trifosfát blokuje virovou DNA-polymerázu a působí jako</text><text x="294.0" y="816.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">terminátor řetězce.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="843.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="849.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">3</text><text x="64.0" y="848.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Krystalurie</text><text x="294.0" y="848.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Nefrotoxicita a krystalurie při nedostatečné hydrataci — při i.v.</text><text x="294.0" y="868.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">podání je nutný dostatečný přívod tekutin.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="896.2" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="902.2" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">4</text><text x="64.0" y="901.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Recidiva</text><text x="294.0" y="901.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Antivirotika jsou převážně VIROSTATICKÁ — potlačí replikaci, ale</text><text x="294.0" y="921.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">latentní virus nevymýtí; proto herpetické infekce recidivují.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="948.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="954.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">5</text><text x="64.0" y="953.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">48 hodin</text><text x="294.0" y="953.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">OSELTAMIVIR a zanamivir blokují NEURAMINIDÁZU a brání uvolnění</text><text x="294.0" y="974.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">nových virionů — účinné jen DO 48 HODIN od začátku příznaků.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1001.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1007.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="64.0" y="1006.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Hepatitida C</text><text x="294.0" y="1006.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Přímo působící antivirotika (sofosbuvir, ledipasvir, glekaprevir)</text><text x="294.0" y="1026.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">vyléčí naprostou většinu nemocných; hepatitida B: tenofovir,</text><text x="294.0" y="1047.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">entekavir, peginterferon.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1074.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1080.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">7</text><text x="64.0" y="1079.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Cytomegalovirus</text><text x="294.0" y="1079.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Ganciklovir a valganciklovir (myelosuprese), rezervně foskarnet a</text><text x="294.0" y="1099.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">cidofovir (nefrotoxické).</text><rect x="27.0" y="1126.1" width="846.0" height="62.5" rx="10" fill="#F7CFC4" opacity="0.42"/><path d="M32.1,1127.6 L870.0,1125.9 Q870.8,1122.9 874.3,1130.8 L873.6,1184.1 Q875.5,1186.9 866.3,1188.5 L33.9,1192.8 Q26.7,1190.4 27.7,1185.7 L27.8,1129.0 Q25.8,1127.6 33.9,1123.2" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><path d="M35.2,1124.9 L869.1,1127.2 Q871.2,1123.3 871.1,1128.6 L871.4,1186.1 Q876.1,1190.5 867.3,1189.4 L33.6,1188.3 Q26.5,1187.9 28.9,1184.1 L25.1,1133.3 Q25.4,1124.7 34.7,1126.8" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><text x="40.0" y="1147.1" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">⚠️</text><text x="66.0" y="1147.1" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">Rezistence na aciklovir vzniká nejčastěji ztrátou virové thymidinkinázy — pak se podává foskarnet,</text><text x="66.0" y="1166.4" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">který aktivaci nepotřebuje.</text></svg>

boostují se</text><text x="294.0" y="896.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">ritonavirem nebo kobicistatem (inhibitory CYP3A4). kombinace</text><text x="294.0" y="697.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Kašel je OBRANNÝ reflex — tlumí se jen suchý dráždivý. Antitusikum</text><text x="294.0" y="718.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">se NIKDY nekombinuje s mukolytikem, hlen by se hromadil.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="745.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="751.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">2</text><text x="64.0" y="750.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Kodein</text><text x="294.0" y="750.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Centrální opioidní antitusikum; proléčivo metabolizované CYP2D6 na</text><text x="294.0" y="770.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">morfin. Zácpa, útlum dechu, návykovost; u dětí kontraindikován.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="798.1" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="804.1" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">3</text><text x="64.0" y="803.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Dextromethorfan</text><text x="294.0" y="803.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Není analgetický ani v běžné dávce návykový, ve vysokých dávkách</text><text x="294.0" y="823.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">disociativní. Butamirát je neopioidní centrální antitusikum.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="850.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="856.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">4</text><text x="64.0" y="855.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Acetylcystein</text><text x="294.0" y="855.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Štěpí DISULFIDOVÉ můstky mukoproteinů, a tím hlen zřeďuje.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="883.1" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="889.1" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">5</text><text x="64.0" y="888.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Antidotum paracetamolu</text><text x="294.0" y="888.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">N-acetylcystein doplňuje glutathion — druhá, zcela odlišná indikace</text><text x="294.0" y="908.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">téže látky.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="935.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="941.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="64.0" y="940.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Ambroxol</text><text x="294.0" y="940.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Ambroxol a bromhexin zvyšují tvorbu řidšího hlenu a sekreci</text><text x="294.0" y="961.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">surfaktantu; dornáza alfa štěpí DNA v hnisavém sputu u cystické</text><text x="294.0" y="981.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">fibrózy.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1008.7" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1014.7" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">7</text><text x="64.0" y="1013.7" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Hydratace</text><text x="294.0" y="1013.7" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Expektorancia (guaifenesin, silice, břečťan) zvyšují objem sekretu;</text><text x="294.0" y="1034.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">základem zůstává dostatečná hydratace.</text><rect x="27.0" y="1060.4" width="846.0" height="62.5" rx="10" fill="#F7CFC4" opacity="0.42"/><path d="M34.8,1057.9 L867.6,1056.4 Q873.9,1057.1 874.3,1068.6 L877.3,1116.7 Q874.1,1126.2 868.5,1122.7 L34.4,1124.1 Q24.9,1126.2 27.5,1118.7 L27.3,1064.1 Q25.9,1059.8 29.8,1058.1" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><path d="M34.7,1059.1 L864.7,1062.2 Q873.5,1061.5 871.5,1063.4 L875.8,1117.9 Q876.3,1126.3 870.5,1123.1 L34.3,1126.6 Q26.6,1127.2 22.8,1121.1 L25.0,1064.7 Q24.9,1061.8 33.7,1061.8" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><text x="40.0" y="1081.4" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">⚠️</text><text x="66.0" y="1081.4" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">U dětí do dvou let se antitusika ani expektorancia zpravidla nepodávají — poměr rizika a prospěchu je</text><text x="66.0" y="1100.7" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">nepříznivý.</text></svg>

nežádoucí účinky: orofaryngeální kandidóza a dysfonie —</text><text x="294.0" y="855.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">brání jim výplach úst po inhalaci a nástavec.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="883.1" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="889.1" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">5</text><text x="64.0" y="888.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">LABA samotné</text><text x="294.0" y="888.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Formoterol a salmeterol se u astmatu NIKDY nepodávají samostatně —</text><text x="294.0" y="908.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">monoterapie zvyšuje mortalitu. Standard je fixní kombinace</text><text x="294.0" y="928.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">kortikoid + formoterol.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="956.1" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="962.1" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="64.0" y="961.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Montelukast</text><text x="294.0" y="961.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Antileukotrien — pozor na neuropsychické reakce. Dále LAMA</text><text x="294.0" y="981.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">(tiotropium) a theofylin (úzké terapeutické okno).</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1008.7" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1014.7" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">7</text><text x="64.0" y="1013.7" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Biologika</text><text x="294.0" y="1013.7" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Omalizumab (anti-IgE), mepolizumab (anti-IL-5) u těžkého astmatu.</text><rect x="27.0" y="1040.1" width="846.0" height="62.5" rx="10" fill="#F7CFC4" opacity="0.42"/><path d="M31.9,1037.8 L869.9,1038.0 Q874.5,1041.0 874.3,1046.0 L874.0,1099.6 Q874.3,1102.5 866.2,1103.8 L32.3,1104.7 Q23.4,1101.4 26.2,1097.7 L26.6,1046.9 Q28.6,1042.0 33.4,1040.0" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><path d="M34.9,1037.2 L868.9,1040.7 Q873.0,1042.2 875.0,1044.8 L872.0,1095.2 Q875.8,1102.2 871.4,1103.6 L33.1,1105.8 Q25.6,1104.2 28.1,1098.5 L26.9,1044.0 Q26.6,1038.4 35.3,1041.3" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><text x="40.0" y="1061.1" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">⚠️</text><text x="66.0" y="1061.1" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">Neselektivní β-blokátory — i v očních kapkách (timolol) — mohou u astmatika vyvolat těžký</text><text x="66.0" y="1080.3" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">bronchospasmus.</text></svg>

váže vodu bez dráždění — dnes lék volby.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="725.1" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="731.1" font-size="17" font-weight="700" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Nevstřebatelný disacharid, který střevní bakterie štěpí na</text><text x="294.0" y="750.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">kyseliny; táhne vodu a SNIŽUJE VSTŘEBÁVÁNÍ AMONIAKU — proto u</text><text x="294.0" y="770.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">jaterní text-anchor="middle">3</text><text x="64.0" y="803.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Bisakodyl</text><text x="294.0" y="803.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">KONTAKTNÍ (bisakodyl, senna, pikosíran) dráždí myenterický plexus;</text><text x="294.0" y="823.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">při chronickém zneužívání hypokalemie a atonie tračníku.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="850.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="856.8" x="294.0" y="855.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Agonista periferních μ-receptorů, do CNS neproniká. NESMÍ se podat</text><text x="294.0" y="876.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">u DYSENTERIE a horečnatého průjmu — riziko toxického megakolon.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="903.4" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="909.4" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">5</text><text x="64.0" y="908.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Rehydratace</text><text x="294.0" y="908.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">U průjmu je zásadní perorální rehydratační roztok, nikoli zástava</text><text x="294.0" y="928.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">peristaltiky. Dále adsorbencia a probiotika.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="956.1" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="962.1" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="64.0" y="961.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Zákaz u obstrukce</text><text x="294.0" y="961.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Laxativa se nepodávají při podezření na střevní obstrukci nebo</text><text x="294.0" y="981.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">náhlou příhodu břišní.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1008.7" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1014.7" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">7</text><text x="64.0" y="1013.7" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Psyllium</text><text x="294.0" y="1013.7" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Objemová laxativa vyžadují dostatečný příjem tekutin; parafinový</text><text x="294.0" y="1034.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">olej zhoršuje vstřebávání vitaminů rozpustných v tucích;</text><text x="294.0" y="1054.4" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">methylnaltrexon a naloxegol na zácpu při opioidech.</text><rect x="27.0" y="1080.7" width="846.0" height="62.5" rx="10" fill="#F7CFC4" opacity="0.42"/><path d="M34.6,1081.3 L867.5,1081.7 Q870.7,1081.7 874.4,1083.4 L870.9,1138.5 Q872.9,1141.4 868.5,1144.4 L32.8,1142.4 Q28.4,1143.6 26.0,1137.1 L26.1,1088.5 Q28.7,1080.5 29.3,1081.3" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><path d="M34.4,1077.9 L871.4,1082.1 Q875.3,1080.1 875.3,1086.0 L876.4,1140.1 Q876.1,1144.4 867.7,1143.7 L33.8,1143.7 Q25.8,1143.2 28.8,1135.1 L26.9,1088.7 Q26.1,1081.8 34.2,1082.7" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><text x="40.0" y="1101.7" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">⚠️</text><text x="66.0" y="1101.7" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">Základem léčby zácpy zůstává vláknina, tekutiny a pohyb — laxativum se nasazuje až po vyloučení</text><text x="66.0" y="1121.0" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">organické příčiny.</text></svg>

mezi agresivními faktory a ochranou sliznice.</text><text x="294.0" y="743.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Léčba tlumí kyselinu, eradikuje bakterii a odstraní vyvolávající</text><text x="294.0" y="763.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">lék.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="790.9" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="796.9" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">2</text><text x="64.0" y="795.9" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Protonová pumpa</text><text x="294.0" y="795.9" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">IPP (omeprazol, pantoprazol, esomeprazol) ireverzibilně blokují</text><text x="294.0" y="816.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">H+/K+-ATPázu — poslední společný krok sekrece, proto nejúčinnější.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="843.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="849.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">3</text><text x="64.0" y="848.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Nalačno</text><text x="294.0" y="848.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Aktivují se jen na sekretující pumpě — podávají se 30 minut PŘED</text><text x="294.0" y="868.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">jídlem, jinak nezaberou.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="896.2" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="902.2" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">4</text><text x="64.0" y="901.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Klopidogrel</text><text x="294.0" y="901.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Omeprazol inhibuje CYP2C19 a snižuje účinek klopidogrelu — volí se</text><text x="294.0" y="921.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">pantoprazol. Dlouhodobě hypomagnezemie, deficit B12, klostridiová</text><text x="294.0" y="941.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">kolitida, zlomeniny.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="969.2" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="975.2" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">5</text><text x="64.0" y="974.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Eradikace</text><text x="294.0" y="974.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">IPP + amoxicilin + klarithromycin (nebo metronidazol), běžně jako</text><text x="294.0" y="994.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">čtyřkombinace s bismutem, 10–14 dní.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1021.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1027.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="64.0" y="1026.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Antacida</text><text x="294.0" y="1026.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Neutralizují rychle, ale krátce a VÁŽOU jiná léčiva — podávat s</text><text x="294.0" y="1047.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">odstupem.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1074.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1080.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">7</text><text x="64.0" y="1079.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Misoprostol</text><text x="294.0" y="1079.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Analog prostaglandinu chrání před NSA, ale je kontraindikován v</text><text x="294.0" y="1099.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">graviditě. Sukralfát tvoří film na spodině vředu.</text><rect x="27.0" y="1126.1" width="846.0" height="62.5" rx="10" fill="#F7CFC4" opacity="0.42"/><path d="M33.5,1122.5 L869.7,1128.2 Q873.2,1122.9 874.5,1134.5 L871.0,1185.9 Q871.3,1188.5 866.2,1188.2 L28.7,1190.8 Q28.1,1188.1 27.3,1182.0 L26.3,1131.6 Q26.2,1128.0 35.0,1125.0" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><path d="M33.7,1124.8 L869.6,1122.6 Q871.3,1128.4 872.2,1130.3 L871.0,1185.4 Q876.7,1188.5 870.0,1187.6 L28.9,1186.8 Q27.0,1189.5 24.1,1185.7 L24.8,1131.6 Q24.0,1126.3 31.6,1122.2" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><text x="40.0" y="1147.1" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">⚠️</text><text x="66.0" y="1147.1" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">Vřed po NSA může krvácet bez varovné bolesti, protože NSA bolest tlumí — proto se u rizikových podává</text><text x="66.0" y="1166.4" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">IPP profylakticky.</text></svg>

text-anchor="start">Prokinetikum</text><text x="294.0" y="722.9" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Metoklopramid (antagonista D2), itoprid, domperidon (do CNS proniká</text><text x="294.0" y="743.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">málo, ale prodlužuje QT) urychlují vyprazdňování žaludku a zvyšují</text><text x="294.0" y="763.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">tonus dolního jícnového svěrače.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="790.9" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="796.9" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">2</text><text x="64.0" y="795.9" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Dystonie</text><text x="294.0" y="795.9" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">METOKLOPRAMID prochází do CNS — akutní dystonie a po delším</text><text x="294.0" y="816.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">podávání tardivní dyskineze; odtud omezení dávky i délky a zákaz u</text><text x="294.0" y="836.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">parkinsonika.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="863.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="869.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">3</text><text x="64.0" y="868.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Ondansetron</text><text x="294.0" y="868.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Setrony blokují 5-HT3 v area postrema a ve střevě — základ u</text><text x="294.0" y="889.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">zvracení po cytostatikách, ozáření a po operaci. Zácpa, bolest</text><text x="294.0" y="909.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">hlavy, prodloužení QT.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="936.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="942.8" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">4</text><text x="64.0" y="941.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Aprepitant</text><text x="294.0" y="941.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Antagonista NK1 proti pozdní fázi po chemoterapii; kortikosteroidy</text><text x="294.0" y="962.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">(dexametazon) v kombinaci.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="989.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="995.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">5</text><text x="64.0" y="994.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Kinetóza</text><text x="294.0" y="994.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Antihistaminika I. generace (prometazin) a anticholinergika</text><text x="294.0" y="1014.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">(skopolamin).</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1042.1" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1048.1" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="64.0" y="1047.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Paliativní péče</text><text x="294.0" y="1047.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Neuroleptika (haloperidol, levomepromazin); kanabinoidy rezervně.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="1074.5" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="1080.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="middle">7</text><text x="64.0" y="1079.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#9C3628" text-anchor="start">Emetika</text><text x="294.0" y="1079.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Ipekakuanha a apomorfin se dnes při otravách prakticky nepoužívají</text><text x="294.0" y="1099.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">— vyvolávat zvracení se nedoporučuje pro riziko aspirace.</text><rect x="27.0" y="1126.1" width="846.0" height="62.5" rx="10" fill="#F7CFC4" opacity="0.42"/><path d="M30.6,1122.7 L865.1,1123.4 Q873.8,1127.1 874.5,1132.3 L874.6,1182.3 Q871.5,1191.8 870.7,1189.7 L33.4,1191.7 Q26.6,1190.5 25.9,1181.3 L25.6,1128.0 Q28.8,1123.8 31.9,1127.3" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><path d="M33.9,1123.2 L867.0,1128.2 Q870.8,1122.7 875.7,1132.0 L874.1,1183.0 Q876.3,1191.4 870.9,1188.5 L34.5,1186.3 Q26.0,1186.8 22.6,1183.3 L26.8,1131.2 Q25.7,1123.3 33.2,1122.0" fill="none" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.8"/><text x="40.0" y="1147.1" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">⚠️</text><text x="66.0" y="1147.1" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">Erythromycin působí přes motilinový receptor a používá se jako prokinetikum u gastroparézy —</text><text x="66.0" y="1166.4" font-size="14.6" font-weight="400" fill="#5E1F14" text-anchor="start">antibiotikum v nemikrobiální indikaci.</text></svg>

x="294.0" y="795.9" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Kortikoidy se k UDRŽENÍ remise nikdy nepoužívají — pro nežádoucí</text><text x="294.0" y="816.2" x="294.0" y="848.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Azathioprin a 6-merkaptopurin udržují remisi; před nasazením se</text><text x="294.0" y="868.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">vyšetřuje aktivita TPMT kvůli riziku myelosuprese. Dále metotrexát.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="896.2" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="902.2" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="middle">4</text><text x="64.0" y="901.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E" text-anchor="start">Mesalazin</text><text x="294.0" y="901.2" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">5-ASA se uvolňuje v tlustém střevě a působí lokálně protizánětlivě</text><text x="294.0" y="921.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">— základ u ULCERÓZNÍ KOLITIDY, u Crohnovy nemoci malý účinek.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="948.8" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#9C3628" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="954.8" x="294.0" y="953.8" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Způsobuje nauzeu, vyrážku a reverzibilní oligospermii.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="981.2" r="15" (infliximab, adalimumab) je nutné vyloučit latentní</text><text x="294.0" y="1006.5" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">tuberkulózu a hepatitidu B — hrozí font-weight="400" fill="#23303A" text-anchor="start">Anti-integrin, střevně selektivní; dále ustekinumab (anti-IL-12/23)</text><text x="294.0" y="1059.1" font-size="15.4" font-weight="400" cest.</text><circle cx="41.0" cy="969.2" r="15" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#28556E" stroke-width="2.4"/><text x="41.0" y="975.2" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#28556E"
